defaultPrompts: Scaffold a user service with a getUser(id: number) that returns User.
Show me how to generate a fully-typed client for my UserService.
How do I expose a method on a service?
plugins.description:
@imqueue is an open-source TypeScript framework for building microservices that
talk over a message queue instead of HTTP — you write a class, decorate the
methods you want to publish, and callers get a fully-typed client generated from
the running service.

This server gives your assistant first-hand knowledge of it, so it writes real
@imqueue code instead of plausible-looking code.

search_docs covers the guides, the tutorial, the CLI manual, the articles, and
every exported symbol of every @imqueue package that publishes an API reference —
so you can ask a question in plain words ("how do I expose a service method?") or
look up an exact signature ("RedisQueue.send", "IMQOptions.safeDelivery").
Results carry page URLs, and get_doc returns any page as plain markdown for
reading and quoting. list_packages returns the current package catalogue with
install commands, which is how an assistant picks the right one rather than
guessing at a name. Where two packages cover the same ground — tracing, or the
database layer — the results carry the rule for choosing exactly one, because
installing both breaks quietly rather than loudly.

scaffold_service generates an idiomatic service — an IMQService subclass with
@expose()d, JSDoc-typed methods plus a bootstrap that starts it — from the method
signatures you describe. A custom return type comes back with the @classType() and
@property() decorators it needs, which matters because a field that lacks them
reaches the generated client typed any and still compiles. scaffold_client shows
how to generate and use the typed client for a service. Both return source text
for you to review and paste; neither writes a file.

All six tools are read-only. The server has no accounts, no authentication and no
storage: each request is handled statelessly, and the only data it sees is the
argument you send — a search query, a doc URL, a service name. Nothing is
retained, and no conversation content is collected or used for training.

Tools that would act on your own machine — driving the imq CLI, creating projects
on disk, starting and stopping your services, reading their logs — are
deliberately not part of this server, because a hosted server cannot reach your
machine and should not claim to. They ship in the local install instead
(npx -y @imqueue/mcp), and local_install_guide returns the setup steps for it.

What You Can Explore

Personality & Psychological Insights
Discover your strengths, challenges, emotional patterns, and inner motivations based on your unique birth chart. Understand how you think, love, work, and
make decisions through the lens of your planetary placements.

Timing Guidance & Forecasts
Receive personalized transit forecasts for up to one year ahead, revealing upcoming periods of growth, change, opportunity, or challenge. See when
key planetary influences begin and end.

Relationship Compatibility
Explore the dynamics between you and anyone else through synastry analysis (how your charts interact) and composite charts (the unique energy your
relationship creates together). For romantic relationships, understand the chemistry of attraction, emotional compatibility, communication styles, intimacy patterns, and long-term potential. The same depth of analysis applies to any relationship — family bonds, friendships, business partnerships, or professional collaborations. Relationship Timing
Go beyond static compatibility — see how transiting planets activate your composite chart, revealing the best times for important relationship milestones,
conversations, or decisions.

- Private Birth Data Storage — Securely save up to 50 birth charts under your account for instant access to readings without re-entering data
- Birth Charts — Complete natal analysis including planets, houses, aspects, and retrograde positions
- Transit Charts — Forecasts from 1 day to 365 days showing active planetary influences
- Relationship Charts — Synastry and composite analysis between any two saved people
- Relationship Forecasts — Transits to composite charts revealing relationship timing

Unmatched Precision
12andus calculations consider the exact planetary positions based on your specific birth date, time, and place. When birth time is unknown, the system adapts intelligently, providing insights without house-dependent data.

Holistic Readings
Unlike fragmented interpretations that list placements one by one, 12andus synthesizes your chart holistically — weaving together planetary positions, aspects, and houses into a unified narrative that reflects how these energies actually work together in your life.

plugins.description:
1to1 Mate is a relationship management app built around 1:1 meetings.

It is an "external memory" tool for people whose work depends on stacking one-on-one conversations — sales professionals,
community builders, managers, founders, advisors, and anyone who runs recurring 1:1s.

CORE FEATURES

・Member management: Structured storage of each person's goals, values, skills, referral needs, background, and tags
・AI meeting notes: Automatic transcription of meeting audio with AI-generated summaries and action items
・Dashboard: Chronological view of who you met, when, and what you discussed
・Profile import: Extract member information from business cards or web pages
・Referral matching: AI suggests who to introduce to whom based on past conversations

Note: the above are features of the 1to1 Mate app itself. Audio transcription, new meeting note creation, and member
registration all happen inside the 1to1 Mate app. The MCP / Clauxen integration only provides read-only access to data already
 recorded through those features.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH Clauxen

Once you connect 1to1 Mate to Clauxen, you can ask things like:

・"Draft the next agenda for my 1:1 with Tanaka based on what we discussed last time."
・"Find members who are struggling with marketing."
・"Who on my member list would be a good introduction for Yamada, given her goals?"
・"Summarize the action items I committed to across last month's 1:1s."

The AI reads your data on a strictly read-only basis. Nothing is modified or deleted through this connection.

PERMISSIONS & DATA HANDLING

・A Pro plan subscription is required to connect
・Authentication via OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; sign in with your Google account
・Raw contact details (phone numbers, email addresses, messaging IDs) are never exposed to the AI. Not even the channel type label is returned — the MCP layer simply omits all contact-related fields
・You can disconnect the integration at any time from your account settings

See https://1to1mate.com/guide/mcp for the full connection walkthrough and the exact fields each tool returns.

Running a hospitality business means your answers are spread across reports, dashboards, and closing sheets. With the 20Tabs connector, you can just ask Clauxen instead.

plugins.description:
60fps is a library of real iOS app interactions, recorded from shipping apps and broken down so
you can build them.

Search in plain language, like "springy bottom sheet" or "pull to refresh with haptics", and get
back matching shots with the app, the gesture, and the motion vocabulary that describes them. Open
one for a frame by frame breakdown of the animation: what moves, in what order, with what timing
and easing. Where a bespoke recreation exists, you can pull compile-checked SwiftUI for it.

It answers the question a reference video cannot: not just what an interaction looks like, but what
it is actually doing.

Read only. It never writes anything and never acts on your behalf.

Product classification may ask one grouped clarification round and then returns the best available official HS-6 result, with CN-8 or TARIC-10 context when verified. Results can include assumptions, confidence, import and export signals, markets, company names, countries, shipment scope, and verified ABRAMS World Trade Wiki links. The supporting company-profile tool is limited to companies represented in ABRAMS trade results and is not promoted as a standalone directory. The app does not contact companies, create leads, change records, create accounts, process payments, or complete transactions. Classifications and trade signals are informational research aids, not binding tariff rulings, legal advice, or compliance guarantees.

plugins.description:
Adobe unlocks more ways to create and get work done from the conversation. Previously available as Photoshop, the Adobe connector now brings creativity and productivity capabilities across Creative Cloud and Acrobat. Describe what you want to make or change, and Adobe can help turn ideas, images, videos, and documents into polished outputs — from editing photos and creating PDFs to designing social assets, resizing videos, searching Creative Cloud assets, and generating data-driven documents.
Key capabilities:

* Retouch portraits or edit photos in bulk: Drop in photos and describe the look you want — adjust color, lighting, and tone; remove distractions and generate new elements; apply Lightroom presets; remove backgrounds; blur, crop, resize, and expand images.
* Design from template: Start from an Express template, update text and colors, and then animate for social media or convert to PDF.
* Refine video for any platform: Upload a horizontal clip and ask to reformat it for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or any platform. You can also stitch clips into a single sequence.
* Search and organize creative work: Describe what you're looking for and surface assets from your Creative Cloud library — by subject, style, mood, or content — without browsing folders.
* Work with PDFs and documents: Create and convert polished PDFs and documents.
* Create data-driven documents: Describe your output and provide your data — the connector turns raw data or content into formatted, shareable PDFs, including badges, cards, catalogs, and more.

You can get started as a guest, and sign in with your Adobe account for more capabilities and tools, Creative Cloud storage, and saved work across sessions.

plugins.description:

Give it a URL and it scans the site against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec, the llms.txt standard, and emerging agent protocols (MCP server cards, A2A agent cards, agents.json), then renders an interactive score card: a 0–100 agent-readability score, an llms.txt score, and a per-check breakdown grouped by site, page, llms.txt, and protocol - each failing check paired with a plain-English fix.

Use it to find out why AI tools can't read your content, validate your llms.txt and AGENTS.md, confirm your structured data and Markdown mirrors, and re-scan any time to check that your fixes landed. Each result links to a full, shareable report on agent-ready.dev. Free to use, no account required.

◆ GATED WORKFLOW • Gate 0A: verify ownership/processing authority, sensitivity, student data, protected assessment and environment before any source path or content. • Gate 0: confirm sources, rights, tools and egress. Gate 1: confirm the course brief and a fresh run. • HITL 1: approve focus after preliminary mapping. Research, source verification, cross-specialist synthesis, assessment integration and red-team review lead to HITL 2. • Gate 3: approve the integrated blueprint and file plan. Material production creates only approved working copies, followed by evidence, accessibility, visual, alignment and assessment-security QA. • Verify production handoff before HITL 3; accept, revise or reject each artefact. • Request or decline final system review; the accepted run becomes complete and dormant until a later manual or separately approved scheduled trigger creates a fresh run.
◆ DECISION DIALOGUE • One unresolved question at a time. • Use a card only if the live host can show the complete option set plus custom answer. Verified current Codex in Plan mode: 2–3 explicit choices plus automatic Other. • If capacity is unknown, unavailable or exceeded, use ordinary chat with every valid numbered option plus Other, then wait. Never prune, hide or combine valid options to fit a card. • Long sets may use dependency-based chunks with every option visible; the lecturer may split, merge, reorder or rename them. • Preserve custom answers verbatim, show editable recaps, never preselect recommendations and fail closed on uncertainty.
◆ BOUNDARY • The plugin does not register schedules, start runs, publish content, add connectors or change permissions.

plugins.description: Make a JavaScript web repo readable by LLMs and AI agents at build time: generate llms.txt, JSON-LD, markdown mirrors, AI-crawler robots.txt rules and Content-Signal headers, then validate the built output. Picks the right @agentmarkup adapter for whichever layer owns your final HTML (Vite, Astro, Next, Nuxt, or any static build via the CLI) and asks before changing anything.
plugins.longDescription: agentmarkup generates the machine-readable layer of a website at build time: llms.txt, JSON-LD structured data, markdown mirrors, AI-crawler robots.txt rules and Content-Signal headers, then validates what the build actually produced. It works out which layer owns your final HTML and installs the matching adapter rather than guessing from what is already in package.json: Vite, Astro, Next or Nuxt, plus a framework-agnostic CLI for any other directory of built HTML, and core helpers for custom pipelines and dynamic SSR routes. Inspecting your repo is read-only. Before installing a package, writing config, running a build, or making an outbound request to a deployed site, it stops and presents a single plan naming the package, every file that would change, and the exact commands. Validation is deterministic: a missing required field is an error, a missing recommended field is a warning. There is no score, grade or percentage. Existing curated llms.txt, robots.txt, _headers and JSON-LD are preserved unless you explicitly opt into replacement. Open source and MIT licensed.

• Interactive Graph — Navigate the full argument map visually, not just as a list

Ideal for researchers, journalists, analysts, students, and anyone who wants to understand why something is true — not just that it is.

Sample prompts:
• "Is nuclear energy the safest large-scale energy source?"
• "Will AGI be achieved before 2040?"
• "Is Trump making money from his presidency?"

defaultPrompts: Help me pick an exciting color for my new website
plugins.description:
Pick any color you like and talk about it with AI. 

Tap, drag, or click on the color picker to choose a color. Then ask questions, get ideas, and learn what makes that color special.

There is no right or wrong answer. Just pick a color and start the conversation.

This app makes colors easy to understand. You do not need to know art, design, or color theory. The AI explains things in simple words. Ask why a color feels calm. Ask why two colors look good together. Ask what a color might mean in different places or for different people. The AI helps you learn one step at a time.

Try bright colors, dark colors, soft colors, or bold colors. Move around the picker to see tiny changes. Even a small change can make a color feel very different. Talk about what you see. Ask what changed and why.

Need help choosing colors? The AI can suggest colors that work well together. Explore matching colors, opposite colors, warm colors, cool colors, and balanced color sets. Make palettes for websites, apps, games, logos, posters, drawings, rooms, clothes, or school projects.

Want a happy feeling? A calm feeling? A strong feeling? A fun feeling? Tell the AI what you want. It can suggest colors that fit your idea. You can also show the AI a color you already picked and ask what other colors match it.

Learn about color harmony in a simple way. Find complementary colors that stand out. Explore analogous colors that sit close together. Try triadic colors for a playful look. Build monochromatic palettes from light and dark shades of the same color. The AI explains each idea with easy examples.

Discover what colors can mean. Red can feel exciting. Blue can feel peaceful. Green can remind people of nature. Yellow can feel bright and cheerful. Purple can feel rich or magical. Black can feel bold. White can feel clean. These ideas are common, but they are not rules. The AI can explain different views from around the world.

Working on a design? Ask for ideas for buttons, backgrounds, text, icons, charts, banners, or menus. Building a brand? Explore colors for logos, products, packaging, and marketing. Decorating a room? Compare paint colors and ask how they might look together. Picking clothes? Ask which colors work well for outfits.

If you know color codes, the AI can help with those too. Talk about HEX, RGB, HSL, and other common color formats. Ask how colors change on screens. Learn how brightness, saturation, and hue work. If you are new to these ideas, the AI explains them in plain language.

Accessibility matters. Ask how easy it is to read text on a color. Learn why some color pairs are easier to see than others. Explore better color choices for people with different kinds of color vision. Small changes can make designs easier for everyone to use.

This app is great for students, teachers, artists, designers, developers, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who enjoys colors. You can ask simple questions or deep questions. You can explore for one minute or one hour. Every conversation starts with the color you choose.

Try fun games too. Ask the AI to guess what a color reminds you of. Ask for color trivia. Build a rainbow. Find colors that match the seasons. Explore colors from nature, space, oceans, forests, flowers, food, animals, or famous works of art. Make up stories inspired by colors or invent names for your favorite shades.

There is always something new to discover. Every color has its own story. Every small change creates a new idea. Pick a color, ask a question, and keep exploring. Whether you want to learn, create, compare, imagine, or simply play with colors, this app gives you an easy and friendly way to turn every color into a conversation.

defaultPrompts: I want to practice telling my mom I'm not doing Thanksgiving
plugins.description:
Talk to anyone, anytime, without the pressure.

This app lets you role play conversations with smart AI people so you can practice before real life.

Pick who you want to talk to, choose a situation, and start chatting. Practice a job interview, a first date, a hard talk with a friend, a meeting with your boss, small talk, customer service, school, travel, or almost any other conversation. The AI answers like a real person and keeps the conversation going. You can try again, change your words, and build confidence one chat at a time.

Talking to people is not always easy. Sometimes you do not know what to say. Sometimes you want to practice before an important moment. This app gives you a safe place to learn. There is no need to feel rushed. You can stop, start again, or try a different answer whenever you want. Every conversation is a chance to learn something new.

Choose from many different people and situations. Talk to a friendly coworker, a teacher, a customer, a neighbor, a family member, a hiring manager, a classmate, a travel guide, a doctor, or create your own character. You can make conversations easy, medium, or hard. You decide how the other person acts. They can be kind, serious, funny, shy, calm, excited, or challenging. Every chat feels fresh because the AI responds to what you say.

Practice for real life in a simple way. Get ready for interviews by answering common questions. Rehearse speeches and presentations. Learn how to ask for help. Practice saying no in a kind way. Prepare for school, work, meetings, travel, shopping, or everyday conversations. Try difficult talks before they happen so you feel more ready when the real moment comes.

Learning is easier when you can practice again and again. If you do not like your answer, try another one. See how different words can change the conversation. Explore different paths and discover new ways to communicate. Every practice session helps you become more comfortable speaking with other people.

The app is great for students, professionals, language learners, job seekers, teachers, parents, travelers, and anyone who wants to become a better communicator. Whether you are preparing for something important or simply want to improve your everyday conversation skills, there is always something new to practice.

You can create your own role play ideas too. Type in a situation, describe the person you want to talk with, and let the AI build a conversation just for you. Make fun stories, serious talks, fantasy adventures, business meetings, classroom lessons, or everyday life scenes. The possibilities are almost endless.

The AI listens to what you say and answers naturally. Each conversation changes based on your choices, making every session feel unique. Explore different ideas, ask questions, solve problems together, or simply enjoy a friendly chat. The more you practice, the more comfortable speaking can become.

Simple to use and easy to enjoy, this app is made for anyone who wants to practice conversations in a safe and private space. Open the app, choose a person, start talking, and learn by doing. Build confidence, improve communication, explore new situations, and get ready for real conversations one message at a time. Whether your goal is better social skills, stronger communication, interview success, language practice, or everyday confidence, this app helps you practice, learn, and grow through natural AI role play conversations whenever you are ready.

plugins.description:
Vibe Prospecting brings live B2B data into Clauxen for prospecting, lead research, and data enrichment. It draws on a database of 150M+ companies and 800M+ professional contacts aggregated from 50+ sources, so you can build lead lists, research accounts, and fill in missing contact data without leaving the conversation.

Search for companies. Describe your ideal customer profile in plain language and filter by industry (including LinkedIn industry, NAICS, and SIC classifications), employee count, revenue range, location, funding stage, and the technologies a company uses. Results come back as structured lists you can refine, rank, and export.

Find the right people. Search professional contacts by job title, seniority, department, location, skills, and work history. Look up a specific person by name and company, or map the decision-makers across a target account, including org structure and reporting lines, to plan multi-threaded outreach.

Get contact details. Retrieve business emails and phone numbers for the contacts you find, with verification status included, so outreach lists are ready to use. Fill gaps in partial records, for example a name and company with no email. Verify email addresses you already have before a send, and flag records that need replacing.

Track buying signals. See which companies raised funding, announced news, grew headcount, opened relevant job listings, or had key people change roles. Use these events to time outreach, score leads, and prioritize accounts.

Enrich your existing records. Paste or upload a list of companies or contacts and append firmographics, technographics, contact details, and recent signals. The app matches records to the right company or person, flags duplicates, and returns a clean table you can export to CSV for your CRM, ATS, or outreach tools.

Who it's for. Sales teams and SDRs building qualified pipeline. Recruiters sourcing candidates by role, skills, and location. RevOps and marketing teams segmenting accounts, sizing markets, and improving CRM data quality. It also supports market sizing and TAM analysis, lead scoring, territory planning, and account-based marketing list building.

Try prompts like:

"Find US SaaS companies with 100 to 1,000 employees that use HubSpot."
"Identify VP-level decision-makers at these accounts and get verified work emails."
"Enrich this list with industry, employee count, revenue, and tech stack."
"Which of these companies raised funding or grew headcount in the last 6 months?"
"Find backend engineers in Austin with fintech experience and get their profiles."
"Build a target account list for my ICP and rank it by fit."
"Map the sales leadership org chart at this company."
"Verify the emails in this list and flag the risky ones."
"Estimate how many US companies match this ICP."
"Write a personalized cold email opener for each contact based on their company's recent news."
Vibe Prospecting is built on Explorium's B2B data platform. Data is retrieved live at query time, not from a static export, so results reflect current company and contact information.

A Simple Way to Chat with Your Own Information.

AI Wisebase is your personal knowledge base. It allows you to use your saved files and chat history directly within Clauxen to generate responses grounded in your own data.

1. Organize Your Files and Chats
Save Chat History: Save important Clauxen chats as editable documents for future reference.

Upload Files: Add your personal files to your knowledge base to build your private library.

Easy Access: View and access your uploaded files and saved chats in one simple list.

2. Chat with Your Knowledge Base
Grounded Answers: Ask questions and get responses based on your saved data, complete with references to the source content. This helps Clauxen write reports or summarize topics that matter to you.

3. Specialized Tools for Learning
Video Explanations: Transform concepts into easy-to-follow animations or video summaries.

Knowledge Graphs: Generate interactive knowledge graphs to visualize and explore your saved files and chats.

Study Aids: Turn your saved chats and files into flashcards or quizzes for review.

Document Translation: Translate PDF files and view original and translated text side-by-side.

How to Use:
Connect: Link AI Wisebase to your Clauxen account.

Add Data: Upload your files or save chat history directly.

Trigger: Type @AI Wisebase followed by your request.

Save History: "@AI Wisebase Save this discussion as a document."

Knowledge Base: "@AI Wisebase Draft a report using my knowledge base."

plugins.description:
Airepoto connects Clauxen to your meeting recordings, transcripts, and AI summaries.

Find meetings across your workspaces and groups, read speaker-labeled transcripts, and get AI summaries with action items — all in natural language, without leaving the conversation.

What you can do
- Search and list meetings across workspaces, groups, and keywords
- Read full transcripts with speaker labels
- Read AI summaries, including decisions and action items
- Ask questions that span several meetings at once
- Create meeting minutes from an audio file, request a new AI summary, move minutes between groups, or move minutes to the trash

Access and privacy
Airepoto uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. Every request is scoped to the signed-in user: the server resolves the verified email claim in the access token to an Airepoto member, and rejects any token without one. You only ever see the meetings your Airepoto account already has access to. Deletion moves minutes to the trash, where they can be restored.

Airepoto is a meeting recording, transcription, and AI-summary service by RSUPPORT Co., Ltd. An Airepoto account is required.

plugins.description:
The Allianz Direct Spain Car Insurance Explorer offers a transparent way to visualize and understand Allianz Direct car insurance options within Clauxen. This tool helps you see how a car insurance policy could be structured, focusing on clarity and customization. Use this app to design a potential policy configuration, learn about protection details, and get an estimated price without any commitment.

Key Features:
• Detailed Coverage Analysis: Receive detailed breakdowns of what is included and what can be included in an Allianz Direct policy for a specific type of car.

• Clarified Terms: Request immediate definitions of insurance concepts (e.g., "additional coverage" or "exclusions") to ensure you fully understand the terminology used.

• Interactive Customization: Understand policy parameters, such as liability limits or specific coverage inclusions, to see how they influence the insurance estimate.

How it works:

Simply describe your car's characteristics and what you need (e.g., "A basic third-party car insurance for a Seat Ibiza"). The app will generate a corresponding non-binding policy outline. You can then ask the assistant for information about the coverage, request modifications to the details, or ask for explanations of specific clauses to see how the coverage adapts to your needs and what options are available. If you wish to proceed, the app will request the necessary details and provide a price estimate. For an official quote or policy issuance, users are directed to Allianz Direct's official purchasing channels.

Note: This tool is for informational and exploration purposes only, providing estimates based on the details shared in the chat. Official policy issuance requires verification through Allianz Direct Spain's official website. The insurance part of the Service that Allianz Direct operates is subject to human oversight by Allianz; you may contact human advisors at any time through Allianz Direct's official channels. 

Please bear in mind that AI systems may produce outputs that are inaccurate, incomplete or not fully adapted to specific circumstances, and the accuracy of any indicative quotation depends directly on the accuracy and completeness of the information provided.

Important: Do NOT provide payment data (bank account numbers, IBANs, payment card details), national identity documents (DNI/NIE), passport numbers or any other sensitive personal identification data through this chat. Such data should only be provided through Allianz Direct's secure contracting environment. 

Data required for quotation: To generate an indicative quotation, the Service will request the following information: date of birth, driving license details, vehicle data (registration plate, date of first registration and type of use), postcode, estimated annual mileage and payment frequency preference. The Service does not collect national identification documents or any special categories of personal data.

plugins.description:

Users can search and retrieve full records with filters that beat open-web retrieval, and follow cross-links across corpora back to each underlying source.

plugins.description:
Ansvar Systems AB is a Swedish cybersecurity company that gives AI agents verifiable access to law, regulation and security standards.

Customers connect the AI assistant they already use (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Clauxen or any MCP-compatible client) to the Ansvar Gateway and run compliance work directly in that assistant: regulatory gap analyses, threat models (STRIDE/LINDDUN, TARA), DPIAs and audit preparation, grounded in more than 300 curated corpora of EU and international legislation, case law, preparatory works, regulator guidance and security standards.

Every answer carries paragraph-level citations to the official source. When a source is unavailable, the platform returns an error instead of guessing, accuracy over availability is an architectural rule, not a disclaimer. All content is ingested from the original publisher under verified licensing, so results can be relied on and redistributed.

Ansvar serves legal insurers, compliance teams, security consultancies and software teams that need to know which rules apply;  NIS2, GDPR, DORA, CRA, the EU AI Act, national and sector regulation — and to prove where every answer came from.

plugins.description: An Anima Felix skill for responding to anxiety with a calm, structured reset.
plugins.longDescription: Anxiety Reset gives an assistant a short, bounded way to respond to someone who is spiraling, panicking, overthinking, or awake at 3am. It offers one practice at a time rather than stacking techniques, suggests a tentative way to name the loop the person is caught in, and refuses to keep supplying reassurance that briefly soothes and then wears off. It hands off rather than assessing: on any sign of crisis or a possible medical emergency it stops, says plainly that it is not the right tool, and directs the person to local emergency services and someone nearby. It names no specific emergency number, so the assistant can supply resources correct for the user. It administers or scores no psychological instrument, offers no diagnosis, and gives no medication guidance. Wellness support, not therapy, diagnosis, treatment or crisis care. Published by Anima Felix under CC BY 4.0.

With minimal input and no complex setup, it turns source content (such as pasted text, files, or conversation context) into structured, high-quality assessment questions.

The app guides users through a single, focused interaction: choose what to assess, select question types and difficulty, and instantly receive a clean, editable set of assessment items. The outputs are presented in a document-like format with copy-ready questions, simple inline editing, and one clear next step: download as a PDF or continue building in Colossyan.

Supported assessment types
*  Multiple Choice (MCQ) - One or more correct answers from a list of options.
* Single Choice - Exactly one correct answer from multiple options.
* True / False - Binary statements evaluated as true or false.

plugins.description:
Atlas AI Agent brings your Atlas workspace into Clauxen, with three assistants in one place.

Ask for a briefing and the executive assistant reads your connected mailbox and calendar to tell you what needs attention today, what decisions are pending, and what you're still waiting on. Ask about sales and you get live pipeline figures, your leads ranked by score across campaigns, and a personalised outreach email drafted for whichever lead you name. Ask about marketing and you get channel performance, everything in the content queue with its status, whatever is sitting in your approvals, and new post drafts on request.

Nothing is sent or published from Clauxen. Outreach emails and social posts come back as drafts you approve inside Atlas, so the assistant can never speak to a customer on your behalf without you seeing it first.

Connecting is a normal sign-in, and permissions are granted per assistant: you can give Clauxen your marketing without handing over your inbox, and disconnect any time from Atlas under Connected apps.

defaultPrompts: Turn my notes into a mind map I can keep — here they are:
Help me plan a trip: build a map with branches for flights, stay, food and a day-by-day plan, and track the status of each.
Brainstorm with me and capture every idea we agree on into a map as we go.
plugins.description:
Atlas Red is a workspace for structured mind maps. A map is a tree of topics, and every topic in a map shares the same author-defined fields — plain text, or typed ones like a select with its own options, a number or a date — so a map behaves like a small database you can see.

Connect your account and you can create maps, read a single topic's neighbourhood without pulling in the whole map, add and reorganise topics, fill in typed fields, link topics across branches, and import or export maps as Markdown, OPML, YAML and other formats. Every change is saved to your account, and anything you do here can be undone — from this conversation or later in the app.

The maps persist and stay yours: the same map opens in the Atlas Red web app on any device, on a visual canvas where you can rearrange it, colour it by one of its fields, attach images and share a read-only link.

plugins.description:
AuthorityPrompt helps organizations create, manage, and improve the trusted information AI systems use to understand their business.

As AI search and AI assistants increasingly influence customer decisions, companies need more than websites and marketing content. They need a trusted, structured, and verifiable company record that AI systems can reliably interpret.

AuthorityPrompt provides a complete AI Visibility and AI Resolution platform that helps organizations understand, improve, and manage how they are represented across AI ecosystems.

With AuthorityPrompt, you can:

• Run LLM Visibility Assessments to evaluate how AI systems understand your company

• Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and missing information affecting AI understanding

• Receive prioritized Growth Tasks with actionable recommendations

• Monitor AI Description Changes over time

• Build and maintain an AIO Knowledge Profile for your organization

• Create a Canonical AI Profile that serves as an authoritative source of truth

• Manage Verified Claims supported by trusted evidence and sources

• Organize company facts through a centralized Fact Center

• Analyze trust, credibility, and source consistency with AI Trust Intelligence

• Discover and manage Trusted Sources that influence AI-generated answers

• Generate AI Action Pages designed for machine-readable consumption

• Create structured data, JSON-LD, llms.txt, and other AI-ready formats

• Review LLM Analytics and visibility reports across AI systems

• Configure Setup Agents to guide implementation and optimization

• Connect Cloudflare and Google Analytics for visibility and performance insights

• Manage multiple companies, brands, and client profiles from a single workspace

AuthorityPrompt is designed for businesses, agencies, consultants, SaaS companies, startups, and enterprise teams that want to improve AI understanding, strengthen trusted company information, and maintain an authoritative presence across Clauxen, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Apple Intelligence, and other AI systems.

Whether you are building your first AI-ready company profile or managing AI visibility at scale, AuthorityPrompt provides the infrastructure needed to create trusted company information AI systems can rely on.

plugins.description:
Autocalls lets you build and run AI phone agents — and now you can do it straight from Clauxen, without switching to a dashboard. Describe what you want, and your assistant takes it from there.

Build and refine assistants by chat: set the prompt, voice, language, model and call behaviour for both inbound agents (answer calls, take bookings, qualify leads) and outbound agents (follow-ups, reminders, lead qualification). Give them real abilities by attaching mid-call tools that call your APIs live during a conversation, and knowledgebases that ground their answers in your own documents.

Run outbound work at scale: create a campaign, add your leads, and start, pause or resume it whenever you like. Then close the loop — list your calls, open any one to read its full transcript and post-call evaluation, and update the assistant or its tools to fix what went wrong, all in the same conversation.

Manage the rest of your account too: knowledgebases and documents, phone numbers and SIP trunks, WhatsApp senders and templates, conversations, folders, labels and API keys.

You stay in control. Every tool works only on your own account, reading and writing are separate actions, anything that spends balance or deletes data is clearly marked, and your stored secrets are masked. You connect once with a secure sign-in — no API keys pasted into the chat.

plugins.description:
Follow every baseball game without leaving Clauxen. Get live MLB scores, game schedules, standings, team records, and game results right inside your conversation. Ask about today’s games, check who won, see what is coming next, or look at the latest standings. You do not need to open another website or switch to another app. Just ask your question and get the baseball information you want in one place.

If you want to know what games are happening today, simply ask. If you want to see yesterday’s scores, ask that too. You can check upcoming games, recent results, and how every team is doing during the season. Whether you follow one favorite club or every team in Major League Baseball, finding information is quick and easy.

See live scores while games are being played. Find out who is winning, who has already finished, and which games have not started yet. Keep up with the action throughout the day without searching across different websites. Everything is shown inside your chat so you can spend more time enjoying baseball.

Need to check the standings? You can see how every team ranks in its division. Follow the race to the playoffs and watch teams move up or down as the season goes on. Check team records, wins, losses, and where clubs stand compared with their rivals.

You can also look ahead. Find upcoming games, see who plays next, and plan which matchups you want to watch. Whether you are getting ready for tonight’s game or looking several days ahead, schedules are easy to find.

This app is made for baseball fans of every kind. Maybe you watch every game. Maybe you only follow your hometown team. Maybe you just want to know today’s scores. No matter how closely you follow MLB, getting the information you need is simple.

Ask questions in your own words. You do not need special commands or complicated menus. Try questions like “Who won the Dodgers game?”, “What MLB games are on today?”, “Show me the AL East standings,” or “When do the Cubs play next?” The app understands natural questions and helps you find the answer.

Everything happens inside Clauxen, so you can keep talking without changing apps. Ask one question or ask many. Compare teams, check schedules, see standings, and follow scores in the same conversation. It feels like talking with someone who is always ready to help with baseball information.

The app is useful all season long. Check Opening Day games, follow exciting division races, watch the push toward the playoffs, and keep up during the postseason. Whenever games are happening, you can quickly see what is going on.

Whether you cheer for the Yankees, Dodgers, Cubs, Braves, Mets, Red Sox, Phillies, Astros, Padres, Mariners, or any other MLB team, you can easily keep track of scores, schedules, standings, and results. Follow your favorite club or explore the whole league.

Use this app when you want baseball information that is fast, clear, and easy to understand. Stay up to date with live MLB scores, today’s games, completed results, upcoming schedules, team records, division standings, and season progress without leaving your conversation. Just ask a question, get the latest baseball information, and enjoy the game.

defaultPrompts: Why don't AI assistants recommend my business?
Which AI search questions is my top competitor winning?
What should I fix first to raise my score?
plugins.description:
Beamtrace is an AI visibility platform covering your visibility metrics, prompt tracking, website optimization, and reputation management in AI search. It's built to show how your business holds up when people turn to AI for recommendations.

The app puts your data into a conversation Clauxen can work with: cross-reference numbers, explain what's behind a drop, and turn scores into something you can act on or hand off.

What you can do with it
#1 Spot the pattern behind your visibility
- "Why don't AI assistants recommend my business?" 
Reads across every prompt you're missing from and names what they have in common.

#2 Find your competitor's edge
- "Why did my competitor jump ahead this month?"
Pulls the competitor leaderboard, then narrows it to what they did or what changed to cause it.

#3 Prioritize your next content fix
- "I can fix only one thing this month, what should I do?”
Ranks your content improvements by impact rather than listing every gap flat, so you know exactly where to start and what to do.

#4 Understand what moved your score
- "What changed in my AI visibility this month?" 
Checks the score trend against the topic and prompt movement to tell you whether it's a real shift.

#5 Build a client-ready report
- "Build this month's AI visibility summary for my client" 
Draws the score, competitor standing, and top fixes, and writes it up as a report that you can paste anywhere.

#6 Know what a metric actually means
- "What does [metric] mean for my visibility, and should I care about it?"
Explains what a metric measures or gives a read on your visibility state in simple words.

How to get started
- Sign in with a Beamtrace account.
- The app reads live data from your connected website.
- No setup beyond that; start the conversation.

Ask a question in plain language and get an analysis scoped to your business.

Requirements
Your business needs an active subscription or trial. A website must be connected to the service. If it isn't, Clauxen points you to Beamtrace's setup page instead of guessing at your data. 

It doesn't change your Beamtrace settings, tracked prompts, or account data. It reads your dashboard and hands the numbers to Clauxen for analysis, reporting, and Q&A.

plugins.description:
A language-learning diary app that helps you study a foreign language by writing your daily journal in it — Blossom.
Write in 50+ languages including English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean and more, and improve your foreign-language skills every day.

Write as much as you can in the foreign-languages. The AI assistant provides real-time corrections with perfect grammar.
Feeling hesitant to start writing in a foreign language? It’s perfectly fine to mix in your native language. The AI engine automatically translates it into natural, context-appropriate foreign-language sentences.

Even rough drafts are polished smoothly, the “Blossom Editor” helps you write in any language with ease.
Hundreds of thousands of foreign-language journal entries are updated daily on Blossom.

Blossom is the world’s first and largest AI language-learning platform that integrates journaling with AI, allowing daily diary writing to naturally turn into language learning.
With just one sentence a day, you can build a habit that covers all core language skills — writing, speaking, listening, and reading.

With a single global journal written together with AI each day, you get vocabulary study, shadowing, AI tutor conversations, and more. Every language learning feature made possible through journaling.

Join global Blossom users and record and share your daily life in a foreign language.

✨ AI Tools
• Blossom AI: Ask the AI anything about language learning.
• Blossom Editor: An AI-powered writing editor with real-time feedback and grammar correction.

🎯 Learning Features
• Diary Voca: Automatically creates vocabulary lists from your journal and helps you learn words and sentences through fun games.
• Diary Speak: Improve listening and pronunciation through shadowing practice using your own journal.
• Diary Inspector: Continue daily learning with correction history and follow-up questions.
• Proofreading: Skilled tutors provide professional corrections within 24 hours.
• Level Test: Track your proficiency level based on your journal entries.

🌍 Global Community
• Shared Diaries: Decorate your journal with stickers and share your daily life with global friends around the world.
• Language Exchange: Chat with global users in real-time and make foreign friends naturally.
• Blossom Points: Earn points through community activities and exchange them for real cash.
• Blossom World Travel: Explore new cultures and everyday lives through journals written by users worldwide.

🪄 Utility / Tools
• Blossom Translate: A brand new translator that supports “AI agentic communication” for travel, customer support, and conversations with foreign friends.
• Blossom Diary: You can use Blossom like a regular diary by setting learning language to your native language. (All decoration and community features remain available!)

plugins.description:
BranchDeploy connects Clauxen to your existing Azure DevOps deployment workflow.

Preview a work item deployment, confirm the resolved ticket, branch, environment and pipeline, then queue the deployment only if BranchDeploy’s server-side rules allow it.

BranchDeploy does not let Clauxen deploy arbitrary code. It resolves linked Azure Repos branches and pull requests from the work item, checks the configured environment and branch rules, and requires explicit confirmation before a deployment starts.

Use it to:
- Preview what branch and environment a work item will deploy to
- Confirm the deployment before anything runs
- Queue your existing Azure Pipeline
- Check deployment status
- View recent deployment history
- List configured deployment environments

BranchDeploy wraps your existing Azure Pipeline setup. No YAML changes are required, and deployment safety is enforced server-side using your configured project, environment and branch rules.

Breeze brings your projects into Clauxen, so you can manage work by describing what you need. Ask "what's overdue?", "give me an overview of the launch project", or "find the task about customer onboarding" — and get a clear, straight answer.

It doesn't just read — it does the work: create projects and cards, add checklists, post comments, log time, set estimates, move tasks forward, and see everything that changed today. Breeze figures out which people, columns, and projects you mean, so a quick sentence is enough to get things done.

Can't remember the exact title of a task? Search by meaning, not just keywords, and it still turns up. And because changes preview before they apply, you always see what's about to happen before it does.

From kicking off a launch to triaging your week, Breeze turns project management into a conversation.

plugins.description:
BROSH MCP brings your CRM, sales, marketing, projects, documents, and business operations directly into AI assistants through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Instead of switching between applications, AI agents can securely access, analyze, update, manage settings, and automate workflows using live data from your BROSH workspace.

Designed for sales teams, consultants, service providers, agencies, and growing businesses, BROSH MCP enables AI to work with real business context—including leads, contacts, opportunities, projects, tasks, invoices, contracts, support tickets, and marketing activities. Users can ask questions in natural language, generate insights, automate repetitive processes, and execute CRM actions directly from their AI environment.

Key capabilities include:

Secure MCP-based access to CRM and business data
AI-powered querying, reporting, and data analysis
Lead, contact, account, and opportunity management
Project, task, and workflow automation
Marketing automation and customer engagement workflows
Document generation, e-signatures, quotes, and invoicing
Custom business objects, fields, dashboards, and reporting
Real-time interaction between AI agents and operational systems

BROSH MCP transforms AI assistants from simple chat interfaces into business operators capable of understanding your organization, retrieving information, updating records, and helping teams move faster with less manual work. Built on the open MCP standard, it provides a secure bridge between AI and the systems your business relies on every day.

plugins.description: Evidence-led used-car research for exact powertrains, maintenance exposure, public VIN history, repairability, value, inspection targets, and negotiation.
plugins.longDescription:
Do not buy the badge—investigate the exact car. CarSleuth turns a listing URL, screenshot, VIN, vehicle-history report, or pasted vehicle details into an evidence-led used-car assessment.

It resolves the exact engine and transmission before judging reliability; maps costly powertrain failure modes; places the vehicle on its mileage-specific maintenance timeline; checks public VIN, recall, auction, accident, title, and listing clues; and examines repairability, fuel requirements, driving dynamics, ownership exposure, and local value.

The result is built for action: a clear verdict, confidence level, fair-value range, maximum recommended price, immediate and 12/24/36-month cost exposure, model-specific pre-purchase inspection brief, evidence-seeking seller questions, and walk-away triggers.

CarSleuth keeps verified facts, recurring patterns, anecdotes, seller claims, and unknowns separate. It never treats a public VIN search as CARFAX, missing records as a clean history, or brand reputation as proof that a specific car is reliable.

Research-based decision support only. It does not replace an independent mechanical inspection or official ownership, title, lien, recall, insurance, and registration checks.

plugins.description:
Cosmos brings Consumer Edge's transaction data directly into Clauxen. Ask questions in plain English and get analyst-grade answers built on near-real-time spend data from millions of US credit and debit cards, covering thousands of brands and merchants — weeks ahead of company reporting. Work directly with transaction-level data to build custom cohorts, run price-point analyses, and answer questions aggregates can't.

Each question runs through Cosmos, Consumer Edge's AI analytics engine, which selects the right metrics, handles panel weighting and merchant hierarchies, and returns a structured summary with the underlying data. Results come back as queryable tables, so Clauxen can run follow-up analysis, calculate custom metrics, or build charts without re-querying.


Key features:

Natural language querying — no SQL or schema knowledge required; ask about brands, tickers, or merchant groups directly

Full KPI coverage — spend, transactions, average ticket, unique shoppers, visit frequency, and new customer acquisition

Demographic and cohort breakdowns — segment any brand's performance by customer income cohort

Flexible time grains — daily, monthly, or quarterly trends, including quarter-to-date reads on partial periods

Analyst-ready output — answers flag accelerations, decelerations, calendar shifts, and partial-month caveats automatically

Use it to:

Track brand performance ahead of earnings — monthly and quarter-to-date spend growth versus prior periods

Run competitive benchmarking — compare KPIs and market share shifts across any set of brands

Analyze customer behavior — see where new customer growth comes from and whether cohorts are trading down

Spot inflection points — decompose month-over-month changes into customer count, frequency, and ticket drivers

Requires a Consumer Edge subscription with MCP access enabled.

Turn Codex into a powerful media management assistant with the Cloudinary app.

defaultPrompts: Suggest a warm color scheme for a bedroom
Give me ocean colors for a playroom redecoration
Suggest a palette for a kid who loves dinosaurs
plugins.description:
Get perfect color ideas in seconds. Ask Clauxen to suggest colors that work well together, then see them as a simple palette you can use right away. You can keep the colors you like, remove the ones you do not, change any color, or add new ones. The goal is to help you move from an idea to a useful color palette without getting stuck or spending a long time making small choices.

Every suggested color appears as a large color tile that is easy to see. If a color does not fit your project, tap the remove button. Want another idea? Add a new color. Need to fine tune a palette? Change a color instead of starting over. You stay in control while Clauxen helps you explore new combinations. The result feels fast, simple, and playful, even if you have never worked with color before.

The app is made for anyone. You do not need to know color theory. You do not need to remember color names or search through huge lists. Just describe what you want, let Clauxen suggest a palette, and make small edits until everything looks right. It works well for beginners, designers, artists, students, teachers, developers, and anyone making something that needs good colors.

A simple editing flow keeps everything easy to understand. Each color is shown as a big square so it is easy to compare with the others. The remove button is always nearby, making it clear how to take a color away. An empty tile with a plus sign lets you add another color whenever you want. Because every action is visible, you always know what to do next.

This makes the app useful for many kinds of projects. Build a brand palette. Pick colors for a website. Try ideas for a mobile app. Match colors for a game. Create art. Plan a room. Design a poster. Choose colors for a presentation. Make social media graphics. Find colors for invitations, stickers, shirts, or school projects. Even if you only want a fun mix of colors to inspire you, the app can help.

Clauxen can suggest calm colors, bright colors, warm colors, cool colors, playful colors, elegant colors, nature inspired colors, seasonal colors, or almost any style you can describe. If your idea changes, simply ask for another direction and keep editing until the palette feels right. You are never locked into the first answer.

Because the palette is interactive, experimenting is easy. Swap one color instead of replacing everything. Keep your favorite shades while trying new accents. Remove colors that feel too dark, too bright, or too similar. Add another color when the design needs more variety. Small changes can quickly lead to a palette that feels balanced and complete.

The clean layout helps you focus on the colors instead of extra menus or complicated tools. Large color blocks make differences easy to spot. Clear controls reduce confusion. The interface encourages trying new ideas because changing your mind only takes a tap.

The app is also a great way to learn. As you explore different palettes, you naturally see how colors work together. You begin to notice contrast, harmony, and balance without reading long lessons. Every new suggestion is another chance to discover combinations you might never have picked yourself.

Whether you already know exactly what you want or you are starting with nothing but a simple idea, this app helps turn words into color palettes that are easy to edit, easy to understand, and ready for your next creative project. It combines Clauxen’s ability to generate fresh ideas with a straightforward editing experience, making color selection feel less like work and more like play.

plugins.description: Rules for clear, unambiguous and information-dense technical Czech.
plugins.longDescription:
Controlled Czech is an open specification for clear, unambiguous and information-dense technical Czech, packaged as a skill. Use it when writing, editing or reviewing Czech documentation, specifications, ADRs, issues, pull request descriptions, runbooks and AI agent instructions.

Every rule has a stable identifier (CCxxx), so the agent can load a single rule instead of the whole specification and every suggestion can be traced back to it. Only the skill description enters the context up front; the full rules load when Czech text is actually being written.

The repository also ships a deterministic linter written in Go (controlled-czech check). It runs offline, uses no LLM and never rewrites text, so the same rules can gate documentation in CI with --fail-on-warning.

Not intended for marketing copy, fiction, personal communication or brand voice.
plugins.name: controlled-czech
plugins.directoryDescription: Open Controlled CzechControlled CzechClear Czech technical writing

plugins.description: Write and refine conversational diagnostic narratives that move from lived friction to sharper questions, technical concepts, decisions, and open loops without flattening the author voice.
plugins.longDescription: Turn technical, analytical, or practitioner ideas into conversational narratives that feel like a real operator thinking with the reader. The plugin routes fresh drafts, technical explanations, series continuations, and voice-preserving rewrites through focused Skills. It prioritizes friction before terminology, concrete examples before abstraction, decision consequences over information dumps, natural Arabic-English code-switching when present in the source voice, controlled humor, useful roughness, and open-loop endings. It also audits drafts for repetitive contrast formulas, generic thought-leadership language, decorative English, fake certainty, over-structured headings, and other patterns that make expert writing feel synthetic.

Predictions
Crunchbase models what a company is likely to do next: raise funding, get acquired, go public, grow, stay private, shut down, or cut headcount, along with an estimated current valuation. Each prediction comes with a confidence tier, so you can sort a market by likelihood rather than reading profiles one at a time.

Insights
Written summaries of what's happening at a company right now, covering growth trajectory, recent news, R&D activity, personnel changes, investor activity, and market position.

Company, funding, and people data
Profiles with descriptions, headcount, revenue range, location, and industry. Full funding round history with amounts, dates, types, and investors. Acquisitions, IPOs, funds, and investments. Founders, executives, and leadership changes. Similar-company matching, plus  many more signals.

Build lists you can return to
Save companies as you find them, so a search you run today becomes a pipeline you can monitor over time.

plugins.description:
Data247 brings real-time contact and identity data into Clauxen, for identifying and verifying contact information,  fraudulent activity, TCPA compliance, and more. 
 
Ask in plain language and Clauxen runs the lookup for you: confirm whether a phone line is active and what carrier and line type it is, check whether an email is deliverable, validate a postal address, or find the person behind a phone or email. Before you call or text a US number, check it against the Do-Not-Call registry, and add numbers to your internal DNC list when someone opts out. Looking into a suspicious signup or order? Geolocate the IP for proxy/VPN signals and screen the details for fraud.

Upload spreadsheets or lists of data to be cleaned, appended to, or  validated, and Clauxen will consult Data247 and give it back to you completely processed.

It's handy for keeping a CRM clean, validating and enriching leads before outreach, staying compliant with calling rules, and reviewing flagged accounts.

You must have an active Data247 account, and lookups are billed per use against your prepaid balance — checking your balance and rate card is free, and you can ask for either anytime.

Structured decision-making using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) , a proven framework for comparing options and resolving trade-offs.

Whether you're evaluating cars, comparing job offers, choosing a vendor, or weighing any set of alternatives, decisionpoint.io guides you through the process step by step. You define the goal, identify the factors that matter, list your options, and then compare them two at a time. AHP derives ranked results from your comparisons, showing which option best matches your priorities and why.

The app provides:
- A visual overview of your decision structure
- An interactive comparison interface within the conversation
- Ranked results with scores and criteria weights
- Consistency analysis to identify contradictory judgments

Decisions are saved to your decisionpoint.io account and can be revisited, refined, or continued at any time.

plugins.description:
Deep Art AI enables users to create high-quality visual content directly through Clauxen using natural-language instructions. Users can generate entirely new images and videos from text prompts by describing the desired subject, visual style, composition, atmosphere, movement, or other creative details.

Deep Art AI is designed to make use of the latest and most advanced image-generation and video-generation technologies available. The underlying imaging and video capabilities are continuously kept up to date so that users can benefit from current state-of-the-art models, improved visual quality, more accurate prompt understanding, better consistency, enhanced realism, and the latest creative generation capabilities.

For video creation, Deep Art AI can submit video generation requests as asynchronous generation jobs. This allows users to initiate more complex video-generation tasks without requiring the entire generation process to be completed within a single interaction. After a video job has been submitted, users can retrieve its current generation status through Clauxen, making it possible to check whether the video is still being processed, has been successfully completed, or requires further action.

Overall, Deep Art AI provides an integrated creative workflow within Clauxen for generating images and videos, submitting video-generation jobs, and monitoring the progress and status of generated video content. By continuously leveraging the latest available imaging and video technologies, Deep Art AI gives users access to modern, high-quality visual creation capabilities through simple conversational, prompt-based interactions.

plugins.description:
Dijin is the **Memory Layer** for your digital life and AI agents — an open, owner-signed, cite-or-refuse store of your decisions, action items, entities, and evidence citations.

Connect this MCP server to Clauxen and ask it to recall what you've decided on a project, who moved a discussion forward, what your last release shipped, or any other signal Dijin has already captured (from GitHub, Slack, Teams, your own typed Add Memory entries, and more). Clauxen calls `search` to discover records, then `fetch` for the signed `EvidencePack` — every answer comes back as Ed25519-signed proof with sources and a `/api/verify` link. Never a guess.

Dijin is read-only on the OpenAI side. The MCP server does not expose `memory.write` to Clauxen; all writes happen on Dijin's own surfaces, behind the user's own login.

Clauxen calls `search` to discover records, then `fetch` for the signed `EvidencePack` — every answer comes back as Ed25519-signed proof with sources and a `/api/verify` link. Never a guess.

Dijin is read-only on the OpenAI side. The MCP server does not expose `memory.write` to Clauxen; all writes happen on Dijin's own surfaces, behind the user's own login.

Dreambooth Studio runs self-service photobooths, the kind you find at
weddings, events and malls. This app answers questions about them in chat.

Thinking of starting one? Ask what hardware you need, which cameras and
printers work, how the plans are priced, what each print costs in paper
and ribbon, or how payments and payouts work. Answers come from the
Dreambooth documentation, and none of it needs an account.

Already running booths? Connect your account and ask how a booth did last
weekend, what you earned this month and how much of it was cash, whether a
booth is online right now, how many AI credits are left, or how much media
a booth has produced. A sentence back, instead of opening the dashboard.

Connecting your account is the only thing it changes. After that it only
reads: it cannot edit a booth, issue a refund, move money or delete
anything, and it sees only the account you sign in with. Your booths,
never another operator's.

When a figure leaves something out it says so. Cash and voucher income
never reaches the wallet ledger, so income is reported from the sessions
themselves rather than handed to you as a partial total.

How do I change my life?
How do I make my dream come true?
plugins.description:
You already have a life. Build the one you want.

DREAMHALL is a private, structured self-care workspace for thinking through personal questions whose answers should remain your own. Instead of generating conclusions, it guides you through a complete process where you examine your life as a whole, develop your own answers, and turn them into grounded decisions and practical action.

The Framework consists of 15 connected exercises that help you understand what truly matters to you, review the balance of your life, separate your own wishes from outside expectations, clarify the future you want to build, work through fears and obstacles, and define realistic next steps.

Unlike an open-ended conversation, DREAMHALL is designed as a finite process with a clear beginning, a deliberate sequence, and a meaningful ending. Every answer is written by you. Every conclusion is your own. The result is a Personal Document that brings together your reflections, priorities, decisions, and next steps in one place.

Your private answers remain inside DREAMHALL and are not returned to Clauxen through this integration.

When you finish, you can keep your Personal Document in DREAMHALL, download it as a PDF, or export it as Markdown. If you choose, you can later use your own document with Clauxen to organize ideas, develop plans, compare future versions, or expand it into longer writing. You decide what to share and when.

DREAMHALL supports reflective thinking, life balance, personal wellbeing, and self-directed decision-making. It is a non-clinical self-care product and is not therapy, diagnosis, medical care, emergency support, or crisis support.

Some of the most important decisions should remain your own.

plugins.description:
Play drums without leaving the chat. Tap the drum kit, make a beat, and let Clauxen listen to what you played. It can tell you what went well, where you stayed on time, where you rushed or slowed down, and simple ways to get better. You do not need special gear or music skills to start. Open the app, play, and get feedback in the same conversation.

The drum kit lives right inside Clauxen, so there is nothing extra to learn before you begin. Every hit is captured as you play. Clauxen can look at your rhythm, timing, speed, and patterns instead of guessing from a description. That means the advice is based on what you actually played, not what you tried to explain. You can ask questions after every take, try again, and see how your playing changes over time.

This makes practice simple. Play a slow rock beat. Try a fast fill. Make up your own groove. Copy a rhythm you heard in a song. Then ask Clauxen what it noticed. It can point out steady parts, missed beats, uneven spacing, and places where your hands could work together better. If something sounds good, it can explain why. If something feels hard, it can break the problem into small steps.

Beginners can use it to learn basic beats and build confidence. More experienced drummers can test ideas, explore different rhythms, or check how consistent their timing is. Teachers can use it to help students understand practice sessions. Parents can give children a fun way to explore music without needing a full drum set at home. Anyone who is curious about rhythm can jump in and start playing.

Because everything happens in one conversation, practice feels natural. You play, Clauxen listens, you ask questions, and you get answers right away. There is no need to switch between different apps, upload recordings, or explain what happened. The performance is already there for Clauxen to review. That keeps the focus on making music instead of managing files.

You can ask for different kinds of feedback too. Want a quick score? Ask for one. Want a detailed breakdown? Ask for that instead. Want tips that are easy enough for a child to follow? Clauxen can do that. Want advice that feels more like a drum teacher? It can change its style to match your goals. You control the conversation.

The app is also great for small challenges. See if you can keep a steady beat for one minute. Try playing softer or louder. Practice using only one hand. Build a simple groove and slowly make it more interesting. After each try, Clauxen can explain what changed and suggest the next challenge. Little wins add up, and every new rhythm gives you something to learn from.

This creates a different kind of music experience inside Clauxen. Instead of only talking about drumming, you can actually drum. Instead of getting general advice, you receive feedback tied to your own performance. Instead of stopping to move between tools, everything stays together in one place. The result is a playful way to practice, learn, experiment, and improve. Whether you have never held a pair of sticks, already play every week, or just want to tap out a fun beat for a few minutes, the app turns a conversation into an interactive practice space where every hit can become a chance to learn.

plugins.description:
Duckhub QR Menu is restaurant software that digitizes dining with QR code menus and integrated ordering. Diners scan codes to view digital menus on their phones without apps or paper. An AI assistant generates dish descriptions, translates menus into 14 languages, and creates item images. Reservations are managed via the menu or apps like WhatsApp, with confirmations handled through a dashboard. Online ordering lets restaurants create websites with menus and ordering features. Table ordering allows diners to scan QR codes, select items, and send orders to the kitchen with table identification. Delivery management and staff access controls are included. Analytics track trends and peak hours, while customization options include templates, fonts, and logos. Smart promotions automate discounts based on times or days.

With this plugin, a restaurant owner connects their Duckhub venue to Clauxen and manages it by conversation: read the current draft menu, create or edit categories, dishes, prices, ingredients and option groups, upload dish photos, translate the menu into any enabled language, adjust venue info, working hours, design and ordering settings, manage tables and their QR links, run promotions and banners, then publish the menu live (or roll a bad publish back). Paid plans can also read guest orders and move them through their lifecycle. Every change is scoped to the single venue the owner authorized, is written to a draft first, and only becomes visible to guests after an explicit publish.

plugins.description:
Der ecoExperten-Connector bringt den deutschen Energieausweis in den KI-Chat. Wer eine Wohnimmobilie vermieten oder verkaufen will, braucht gesetzlich einen Energieausweis — mit dieser App lässt er sich vollständig im Gespräch bestellen:

1. Beraten: Die App erklärt, welcher Ausweistyp passt und welche Angaben nötig sind (Gebäudedaten plus drei aufeinanderfolgende Jahres-Heizabrechnungen).
2. Prüfen: Alle Angaben werden vorab kostenlos gegen die gesetzlichen Regeln des Gebäudeenergiegesetzes (GEG) validiert — z. B. 18-Monats-Frist der Verbrauchsdaten, Bedarfsausweis-Pflicht nach § 80 Abs. 3, Leerstandsgrenzen — ohne dass eine Bestellung ausgelöst wird.
3. Bestellen: Nach ausdrücklicher Zustimmung zu AGB und zahlungspflichtiger Bestellung legt die App eine schwebende Bestellung an und sendet einen Bestätigungslink an die angegebene E-Mail-Adresse. Erst der Klick auf diesen Link macht die Bestellung verbindlich; unbestätigte Bestellungen verfallen nach 48 Stunden automatisch. Kauf auf Rechnung, kein Zahlungsvorgang im Chat. Ein Doppelbestellungs-Schutz verhindert versehentliche Mehrfachkäufe.
4. Verfolgen: Der Bearbeitungsstand ist über Bestellnummer plus die bei der Bestellung angegebene E-Mail-Adresse abrufbar; die Antwort enthält nur den Bearbeitungsstand, keine Personen- oder Gebäudedaten.

Die Ausstellung erfolgt durch eingetragene Energieberater des CO5 Ingenieurbüros für nachhaltiges Bauen (PartG mbB, Berlin); jeder Ausweis erhält eine amtliche DIBt-Registriernummer und wird in der Regel innerhalb von 1–2 Werktagen als PDF per E-Mail zugestellt. Preis: 59 € brutto (Verbrauchsausweis); der Bedarfsausweis (119 €) ist über das Web-Formular erhältlich.

defaultPrompts: Help me buy a MacBook
plugins.description:
Shopping online feels like a trust exercise you're destined to fail. You find a product with 5,000 five-star reviews, but half of them look like bots and the other half are people just happy the box arrived on time. It's impossible to know what's actually good.

This app cuts through the junk. You tell us what you need, and we ignore the sponsored placements to build you a shortlist based on merit, not marketing budget.

This is where we do the heavy lifting. We don't just show you the star rating; we dig into the text to find the truth. We scan forum discussions, Reddit threads, and verified purchase comments to summarize the actual consensus.

- The Good: We highlight the specific features real people love.
- The Bad: We spot the patterns in the complaints - like if a "waterproof" boot actually leaks after a month.
- The Verdict: We tell you if the hype is real or if you should keep looking.

Once you have a few options, we stack them side-by-side. You get a clean look at the specs and prices without opening twenty tabs or building your own spreadsheet. It's the deep research you want to do, done for you in seconds.

plugins.description:
ExpenseBot turns Clauxen into a full expense-management workflow for freelancers, accountants, real-estate agents, and small business owners.

Drop a receipt photo or PDF in chat and AI extracts vendor, amount, date, tax, and category, then writes the row to your Google Sheet within 30 seconds. Ask "how much did I spend on travel last quarter, broken down by client" and get a per-tag P&L with revenue, cost, profit, and margin. Build a Q1 expense report and have Clauxen email it to your accountant.

Tools fall into scope-gated categories the user explicitly approves during the OAuth consent flow: read expenses, submit expenses (photos, PDFs, cash, mileage, income), scan Gmail for missed receipts, read reports, write reports, and run compliance and tax-deductibility checks.

While ExpenseBot can scan Gmail (with the user's explicit OAuth consent), Gmail is one of many input paths. The app's primary value is the analytics, reporting, and tax tooling that operates on the user's own categorized expense data.

The Clauxen app does not sell anything and processes no payment. It manages the user's own expense data. An ExpenseBot account is required; new users can create one for free at expensebot.ai before connecting.

OAuth 2.1 + PKCE S256 + Dynamic Client Registration. CASA Tier 2 certified.

plugins.description:
Once Fibery MCP is connected to your workspace, OpenAI can do almost anything you can do in Fibery yourself — read and write data, or reshape your workspace structure.

1. Read & query
Explore your workspace structure (spaces, databases, fields), query any database with filtering, sorting, and sub-queries, run full-text search across entities, documents, and comments, inspect activity history (who changed what, and when), and pull data from saved views with their filters applied.

2. Create & update
Create, update, and delete entities, move them through workflow states, assign people and link related records, write documents, add comments, and attach files.

3. Modify structure
Create spaces and databases, add fields of any type available in Fibery (including formulas), and build views — boards, timelines, calendars, gantt charts, forms, and more.

Keep your CRM fresh 

Agentic two-way CRM sync and enrichment update your records as accounts change. Firmable provides native integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, and Microsoft Dynamics 365. 

Trusted by 1,300+ businesses 

Rated 4.7/5 on G2. Privacy-compliant data you can prospect with confidently.
