defaultPrompts: Suggest fonts for my new website
plugins.description:
AI Font pairing for Designers.

Find beautiful font combinations in seconds with AI. Instead of trying dozens of fonts by hand, describe your project and get a complete font trio made for it. Each triplet includes a heading font, an accent font, and a body font that work well together. Whether you are building a website, designing a logo, creating a brand, making a presentation, or working on a social media post, this tool helps you choose fonts with less guesswork and more confidence.

Good typography can make a design feel clean, modern, friendly, bold, elegant, or playful. Picking the right fonts is often one of the hardest parts of design. Many fonts look great on their own but do not look good together. This app helps solve that problem. Tell the AI about your project, your audience, or the feeling you want, and it suggests font triplets that match your goals.

You can ask for styles like minimal, luxury, vintage, futuristic, editorial, corporate, creative, fun, classic, or high-tech. You can also describe your audience, your industry, or your brand personality. The AI uses your ideas to recommend fonts that fit the mood while keeping the design easy to read.

Every recommendation includes three fonts with different jobs. The heading font grabs attention. The accent font adds personality. The body font keeps long text clear and comfortable to read. Together they create a balanced typography system that is easier to use across websites, apps, presentations, posters, packaging, marketing materials, and more.

The app is useful for graphic designers, UI and UX designers, web designers, product designers, marketers, students, content creators, agencies, freelancers, startup founders, and anyone who wants better typography without spending hours testing font combinations.

You can keep asking for new ideas until you find the style you like. Try different moods, industries, audiences, or visual directions. Ask for alternatives, compare different looks, or explore fresh creative ideas. The AI can help you move from rough concepts to polished typography much faster than searching through large font libraries.

Whether you need fonts for a modern landing page, a restaurant menu, a fashion brand, a technology company, a portfolio, a mobile app, a book cover, a newsletter, or an event poster, the app helps you discover combinations that fit the project.

This tool works well during brainstorming, early design exploration, and final design decisions. It can help you avoid common pairing mistakes and give you inspiration when you feel stuck. It is also useful when you want to experiment with styles you might not have considered before.

If you already have one font picked, you can ask for matching options to complete the set. If you only know the feeling you want, the AI can start from that instead. The conversation is flexible, making it easy to refine results until they match your vision.

Instead of spending time comparing endless font lists, start with a strong typography system designed around your project. Save time, discover new ideas, and create designs with more consistency using AI-powered font triplets built for real design work.

defaultPrompts: Show the Premier League table
plugins.description:
Follow every match in one simple place. This Clauxen app helps you see fixtures, live scores, results, league tables, and team details without jumping between lots of websites. Pick your league, choose your favorite club, and quickly find the games and information you want. Everything is laid out in a clean, easy-to-read view so you can spend more time enjoying football and less time searching for it.

The app is made for everyone. You do not need to know football statistics or understand complicated menus. If you only want to know who is playing today, you can. If you want to check how your team is doing in the league, you can do that too. Every screen is designed to be simple, fast, and easy to understand.

Browse competitions from around the world, including the biggest leagues and tournaments. Select a competition to see the current standings, upcoming fixtures, completed matches, and club information. Change leagues with a tap and instantly see new results. Whether you support one team or follow many competitions, the app keeps everything together in one place.

Choose any team to make the experience even more personal. When you select a club, you can quickly find its upcoming matches, recent results, and position in the table. No more scrolling through pages filled with teams you do not follow. The app helps you focus on the football that matters most to you.

The league table is clear and easy to read. See each club’s position, matches played, wins, draws, losses, points, and goal difference at a glance. Tables update as results change, making it simple to keep track of the season. Whether your team is chasing the title, fighting for Europe, or trying to avoid relegation, you can see where they stand in seconds.

Match information is presented in a clean and organized way. Check who is playing, when the match starts, and how the game ended once it is finished. Live scores and completed results are easy to follow, helping you stay connected even when you cannot watch the match.

The simple design works well on different screen sizes and keeps distractions to a minimum. Clear navigation makes moving between competitions, teams, and matches feel natural. Large text, familiar football icons, and organized tables make information easy to find for both new and experienced fans.

Because the app runs inside Clauxen, you can also ask questions naturally. Instead of searching through menus, you can ask about a team’s recent matches, league position, or upcoming fixtures. Clauxen helps you find answers quickly while the app presents the information in a structured format.

Whether you follow football every day or only check scores on weekends, this app saves time. It brings together fixtures, results, standings, and team information in one place so you always know what is happening. It is useful before a match, during the action, and after the final whistle.

Key features include:

* Easy competition selection.
* Team filtering for faster browsing.
* Live scores and finished match results.
* Upcoming fixtures.
* League tables with wins, draws, losses, points, and goal difference.
* Clean, simple interface.
* Fast navigation between competitions and clubs.
* Natural language support through Clauxen.

From the first match of the season to the last, this app makes following football simple. Open it, choose a league, pick a team, and see the information you need in just a few taps. Whether you support a local club, a Premier League giant, or teams from leagues around the world, this app keeps football easy to follow, easy to understand, and always close at hand.

Connect your AI assistant directly to the heartbeat of global financial markets. The Forinvest MCP (Model Context Protocol) app transforms Clauxen into a powerful financial agent with 22 MCP tools, providing secure, low-latency access to:

plugins.description:
Forms are easy to need and annoying to build. Every question type, every section break, every setting is another click - and by the time responses arrive, reading them is its own chore. This plugin moves all of it into the conversation.

Build a form by describing it. Say what you're collecting — a customer satisfaction survey, an event signup, a job application screener, a 20-point quiz for your class — and it's created in your account, with sensible question types chosen for you: multiple choice where the answers are known, scales for ratings, short text where they aren't, required fields where they matter.

Keep editing in plain language. Add a question in the middle. Reword the confusing one. Move it to page two. Make question 4 worth double. Drop the one nobody answers. Every change lands on the live form — no rebuilding from scratch, no digging through the editor to find the right toggle.

Set it up properly, without hunting for settings. Turn a form into a graded quiz, collect email addresses, limit it to one response per person, open or close it to responses - all by asking.

Then actually read the results. Find any of your forms by name, pull the responses, and ask real questions of them: What's the overall sentiment? What are the three most common complaints in the open-text box? How did answers differ between the two groups? Free-text feedback - the part that usually goes unread because summarizing 200 answers by hand isn't happening - gets read and summarized for you.

Works with the forms you already own, not just new ones.

plugins.description:
Fraghab is a fragrance collection manager. It tracks the bottles and decants you own, how much is left in each, what you wore and when, and what you are saving up for.

Connect it and you can work with your own shelf in plain language. Ask what you have not worn since spring and it reads your collection. Say you wore the Santal 33 decant today, four sprays, and it logs the wearing and deducts the millilitres. Add a bottle you just bought in a sentence instead of a form, correct a rating or a note on one you already have, group bottles onto shelves, and save the layering combos you actually wear.

It also prices your wishlist. Ask for the best price on something you are saving for and Fraghab searches fragrance retailers for the cheapest current offer, tells you which shop has it, and gives the entry a product photo.

You authorize the connection on a Fraghab screen and approve each permission. Nothing can be deleted through it. Editing replaces what was there, so Clauxen asks before it changes something you already had. Changing your Fraghab password revokes access immediately. Fraghab is free and takes no payment of any kind.

plugins.description:
Getir lets you order groceries without leaving your Clauxen conversation. Start with a natural sentence like "order milk, bread, and eggs to home." The app connects to your account, lets you pick from your saved delivery addresses, builds your cart, and hands you off to the Getir mobile app to complete payment. Each step appears as a small interactive card directly in the chat.

You get two delivery options in one place. Getir handles on-demand convenience baskets delivered in minutes; GetirBüyük covers same-day large-basket delivery for weekly shopping with a broader assortment. You can switch between them inside the conversation depending on what you need.

You can search products in natural language and see live price and stock, choose from saved addresses or add a new one, and add, remove, or bulk-update items in your cart. Asking something like "plan a shopping list for the weekend" generates a multi-item list you can review and confirm. Featured deals and recommendations are available in the same flow. When you are ready to order, payment is completed in the Getir app or in your web cart.

Your account and payment data stay with Getir. Only the information needed to fulfill the order is shared with Clauxen, and payment data is never sent to Clauxen.

plugins.description:
GovQuery is a powerful search engine that makes U.S. government reports and data easier to explore, locate, and understand.
 
Built by the Program Integrity Alliance, GovQuery processes over 300,000 articles, reports, and oversight recommendations to make them more digestible for AI platforms — offering deeper, more targeted search than general-purpose engines. Every result links to the exact page where content appears, and you can filter by granular categories unavailable on the source platforms.
 
Data sources currently include:
 
- Reports from the Government Accountability Office (GAO), federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), and the Congressional Research Service (CRS)
- Department of Justice press releases
- Executive orders (last six presidents)
- Annual federal CJ/AFR/PAR agency reports (since 2019 for Chief Financial Officers (CFO) Act of 1990)
 
GovQuery also includes all open oversight recommendations from the GAO and federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), with tools to analyze them by category and track trends over time.
 
New data sources are added regularly.
 
You can register for a free account at: https://www.programintegrity.org (click on the person icon top-right)

For more information on GovQuery data, please see our FAQ (https://www.programintegrity.org/faq).

plugins.description:
Create beautiful color gradients with plain English.

This GPT helps you design, improve, explore, and refine gradients for websites, apps, logos, presentations, social posts, games, illustrations, and anything else that uses color. You do not need to know color theory or CSS. Just describe what you want, and it will help you create gradients that fit your idea.

You can ask for soft, bold, bright, dark, warm, cool, modern, vintage, playful, elegant, natural, futuristic, or minimal styles. You can start with one color, two colors, a mood, a brand, or even a simple sentence. The GPT turns your idea into well-balanced gradient suggestions and explains why they work in clear, simple language.

It can create linear, radial, and other common gradient styles. If you already have colors, it can improve them. If you only have an idea, it can suggest colors from scratch. If something feels “off,” it can recommend small changes that make the whole design look better.

This GPT is useful for designers, developers, marketers, students, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who wants better-looking colors without spending hours experimenting.

You can ask for things like:

• A sunset gradient for a landing page.
• A modern blue gradient for a SaaS product.
• A calm background for a meditation app.
• A colorful gaming theme.
• A luxury black and gold look.
• A pastel gradient for invitations.
• A nature-inspired palette.
• A dark mode background.
• A hero section gradient.
• A gradient based on your company colors.

If you are building a website, the GPT can suggest gradients that feel clean, readable, and professional. If you are making an app, it can recommend combinations that support the style you want. If you are creating marketing graphics, it can generate eye-catching backgrounds without overwhelming your content.

It can also explain why certain colors work together, how warm and cool colors change the mood, and how contrast affects readability. The explanations are simple enough for beginners while still being useful for experienced creators.

Need inspiration? Ask for dozens of ideas. Want something unique? Ask for unexpected combinations. Want something safe? Ask for classic choices. The GPT adapts to your goals instead of giving the same answers every time.

You can refine results by saying things like “make it brighter,” “less purple,” “more premium,” “more playful,” “higher contrast,” “better for dark mode,” or “closer to nature.” Each request builds on the last so you can quickly explore different directions.

Developers can ask for CSS gradients or color values. Designers can focus on appearance. Beginners can simply describe what they imagine without worrying about technical details.

This GPT works well for websites, mobile apps, dashboards, presentations, posters, logos, illustrations, social media graphics, game interfaces, email banners, portfolios, branding, product mockups, wallpapers, and digital art.

Whether you need one quick gradient or want to explore many creative directions, this GPT helps you move from idea to polished result in minutes. Describe the feeling, purpose, audience, or colors you have in mind, and receive thoughtful gradient suggestions that are easy to understand, easy to refine, and ready to use in your next project.

Use MCP when you're already working on something bigger:

-   Writing PRDs or proposals: Pull customer feedback, stakeholder input, and decisions from relevant meetings directly into your draft
    
-   Building presentations or reports: Combine insights from multiple conversations with your other research and data
    
-   Coding with context: Give your AI the project background, requirements, and technical decisions discussed in planning meetings
    
-   Strategic analysis: Merge meeting insights with documents, data, and other sources for comprehensive analysis

Your AI assistant can search your Granola meetings by topic, person, company, or timeframe - then cite specific conversations in its responses. No more switching tabs to find "what the customer said" or "when we decided that."

The difference:

Instead of copy-pasting meeting notes into prompts, your AI pulls exactly what it needs from your meeting history automatically. You stay focused on the work, not the research or context.

It breaks work into explicit nodes with dependencies, access levels, expected outputs, evidence requirements, attempt limits, and clear statuses. Graph Mode can run independent research or inspection branches in parallel, safely join their results, verify completion with deterministic evidence, and perform one bounded repair cycle when verification fails.

Use it for repository audits, feature implementation, parallel research, maker-reviewer workflows, monitoring, and other multi-step tasks where control flow and proof of completion matter.

Graph Mode does not expand the user’s permissions or scope. External writes, destructive actions, and materially ambiguous decisions remain approval-gated. Every run ends with a clear terminal state and reports the executed path, evidence, changes, blockers, skipped branches, and remaining uncertainty.

Meet Hero, your AI teammate for Sales. Hero can join your calls, write your follow-ups, research accounts, and help you keep every deal moving. This connector provides Clauxen read-only access to your Hero data so you can get Hero’s insights wherever you work best. 

What you can do in Clauxen with the Hero connector
• Search meeting transcripts by keyword, meaning, date range, or workspace to  pull the full transcript with per-speaker segments.
• Find and read Hero-generated artifacts like call summaries, account research, saved notes, and uploaded files.
• Browse and revisit your Hero conversation threads.
• Get a list of your Workspaces (accounts and deals) to scope your work. 

Example prompts
• “Summarize my calls with Acme this month, and draft a follow-up email.”
• “Can you tell me what objections came up during yesterday’s demo with Hooli?” 
• “Pull the account research Hero wrote for Globex and turn it into a one-pager.”
• “Find every call where pricing came up this quarter.”

Security and Privacy
• Sign in with secure OAuth: no passwords or API keys to manage.
• Strictly read-only: Clauxen can retrieve your Hero data but cannot create, modify, or delete anything.
• Scoped to your own account: Clauxen only sees data you already have access to in Hero
• Requires a Hero account: get started at meethero.ai.

plugins.description:
Get NHL scores, schedules, standings, team details, player information, and game updates without leaving your chat. This app brings hockey information right into your conversation. Ask a question in plain English and get a clear answer. You do not need to search many websites or open another app. Everything stays in one place, making it fast and easy to follow the NHL.

Want today’s scores? Just ask. Want tonight’s games? Ask that too. Need the latest standings? The app can show them. You can check team records, player stats, game times, and much more. If you want to know who won, who is playing next, or how your favorite team is doing, simply ask.

The app works like a hockey helper. You can ask short questions or longer ones. You can say things like “Who plays tonight?”, “Did the Oilers win?”, “Show me the Eastern Conference standings,” or “When do the Rangers play next?” The app understands natural language, so you do not have to learn special commands.

Follow one team or every team. Keep up with the regular season, the playoffs, and important games. Find schedules, scores, and standings in seconds. Whether you watch every game or only check in once in a while, the information is easy to find.

Player information is also simple to explore. Ask about a player and learn which team they play for, their position, and other useful details. Compare players, check team matchups, or look up game information before the puck drops.

Need a quick answer during a game? Ask for the live score. Want to know what happened after the game ends? Ask for the final score. Looking ahead? Check upcoming games and schedules. Looking back? Review recent results. The app helps you stay connected all season long.

Everything happens inside your conversation. There is no need to jump between tabs or search through many pages. Just ask another question and keep going. It feels like talking with a friend who always knows what is happening around the NHL.

The app is built to be clear and easy to use. Answers are organized so they are simple to read. Whether you ask one question or many, the goal is to help you find hockey information quickly.

Great for longtime fans. Great for new fans. Great for people learning about hockey. If you know every player, you can dive into detailed information. If you are just starting to watch the NHL, you can ask basic questions and learn as you go.

Use the app to check scores before work, during lunch, after school, or before bed. See who is winning, who is climbing the standings, and what games are coming next. Keep track of your favorite team throughout the season without extra searching.

You can ask about today’s games, tomorrow’s games, team records, conference standings, division standings, schedules, results, matchups, and more. The app is made to help you find hockey information in a simple and friendly way.

Whether you want a fast score check, a full schedule, the latest standings, player information, or answers to everyday NHL questions, this app keeps everything together inside Clauxen. Ask, explore, and stay up to date with the National Hockey League from one easy conversation.

Connect once, then ask in plain language for valuations, comparable sales, rental and flip returns, renovation costs, owner details, and Full Property Reports. No spreadsheets or manual data pulls.

Ask about any US residential address and get property investment metrics, an automated valuation (AVM), comparable sales with after-repair value (ARV), and an AI-assessed property condition, including analysis of listing photos or your own images. The Price Flexibility Score, a Homesage.ai signature signal, predicts how negotiable a seller really is.

For investors, Homesage.ai projects fix-and-flip returns, renovation costs with room-by-room breakdowns, and both long-term and short-term rental economics such as cash flow, cap rate, NOI, and cash-on-cash return.

Screen entire markets with ZIP-level sold data and Market Outlook scores, or search the national property database with investor filters for price, condition, equity, distress signals, and more.

Additional tools cover solar potential and AI roof analysis, mortgage and lien records, pre-foreclosure status, location risk flags, and owner skip-tracing for outreach.

Most analytics tools consume credits from your Homesage.ai account, and each tool's credit cost is listed in its description. The property database search always previews the result count and cost for free before charging.

Homesage.ai reads property data and returns analysis. It does not modify your account, move funds, or take actions on your behalf. Coverage is US residential properties only, and comparable-sale and ARV data is limited in non-disclosure states where sale prices aren't public.

plugins.description:
HOUSE ’N’ STARS is a read-only AI-native luxury real estate dataset connector for Clauxen.

It allows users to search and retrieve real public luxury property listings from the HOUSE ’N’ STARS structured dataset, including Monaco, the French Riviera, Dubai, Abu Dhabi and selected international luxury destinations.

The app helps Clauxen access public property data such as title, location, property type, Sale/Rent status, price display, bedrooms, bathrooms, surface, features and public listing URL.

Listings are supplied by professional real estate agencies admitted to the HOUSE ’N’ STARS platform. The platform applies a curation and quality-control layer to support reliable discovery, structured presentation and a consistent user experience.

The connector is strictly read-only and public-data-only. It does not create, edit, delete, reserve, buy, sell or publish properties. It does not request or process sensitive personal data, payment details, identity documents, financial documents or precise user location. It also does not provide legal, financial, valuation or investment advice.

- Search thousands of expert interviews across public and private companies, sectors and business models

- Look up companies and the moats behind them, assessed with the 7 Powers framework: scale economies, network effects, counter-positioning, switching costs, branding, cornered resource and process power

Access requires an In Practise library subscription. Learn more at inpractise.com.

plugins.description:
Need to know if a website is down? Type its address and I’ll check it for you. 

I quickly test if the site can be reached and tell you what I find in clear, simple words. If the site is working, I’ll say it is online. If it is not working, I’ll explain that too. You do not need special computer skills. Just ask, and I’ll do the checking.

This is helpful when a page will not load, an app will not connect, or a service seems broken. Many problems look the same, but they can have different causes. A website may be down for everyone. It may only be blocked for you. Your internet may have a problem. The site may be slow. I help you understand what is most likely happening so you know what to try next.

Using me is easy. Tell me the website you want to check. You can paste a full web address or simply type the name of the site. I will test whether it can be reached and share the result in plain English. If there is useful extra information, I will explain what it means without lots of hard words.

You can check almost any public website. News sites, shops, games, schools, blogs, company pages, and online tools can all be checked. If a page is public on the internet, I can usually test whether it is responding. If a site cannot be checked for a technical reason, I will tell you instead of guessing.

If a website is online, I can help you think about why it still is not working for you. Maybe your browser needs to refresh. Maybe your internet connection has a problem. Maybe a VPN, firewall, or network setting is getting in the way. Sometimes waiting a few minutes is enough because a busy service starts working again.

If a website is down, I explain that in a simple way. I will not make up reasons or pretend to know something I cannot see. If there is not enough information, I will say so. Clear answers are better than confusing ones.

This tool is useful for everyone. Students can check school websites before class. Families can see if a favorite game or video site is having trouble. Workers can test company pages before reporting a problem. Developers can quickly check a public site before spending time looking for bugs. Support teams can use it as a fast first step when helping customers.

You can ask things like “Is this website down?”, “Can you check example.com?”, “Why won’t this page load?”, “Is the server online?”, or “Can anyone reach this site?” I understand many different ways of asking the same question, so you do not have to use special commands.

My goal is to save you time. Instead of trying many different things, start with a quick check. Knowing whether a website is online or offline helps you decide what to do next. That can stop wasted time, reduce worry, and make fixing problems much easier.

I focus on giving short, useful answers first. If you want more detail, just ask. I can explain what the result means, what you can try next, and which common problems might fit the situation. I keep the language simple, avoid unnecessary jargon, and stay honest about what I know.

Whether you are checking one website or many, I aim to make the process fast, clear, and easy. Paste a web address, type a site name, or ask if a service is down. I’ll check its reachability, explain the result, and help you understand what to do next.

defaultPrompts: what does this bug report show?
plugins.description:
Jam for Clauxen connects your Jam screen recordings to Clauxen. When you paste a Jam link, the app pulls in rich debugging context from that recording, including video, user events, console logs, errors, and network requests. Clauxen can then use this data to help you understand, fix, and organize product issues.

Use Jam for Clauxen to:
• Explain what went wrong in a recording and why
• Turn a Jam into an engineering ready bug ticket
• Write test cases based on the exact user steps
• Summarize a customer’s experience and impact
• Group similar Jams into themes or issue clusters
• Plan code changes based on real traces, not guesses

How it works:
1. Record an issue or user session with Jam.
2. Copy the Jam link, for example https://jam.dev/c/UUID.
3. In Clauxen, paste the Jam URL and ask what you want to do, such as:
        •        “Find the root cause of this bug.”
        •        “Write a Jira ticket from this Jam.”
        •        “List clean reproduction steps from this recording.”
        •        “Group these Jam links into related issues.”

defaultPrompts: When am I free for two hours this week?
How much time do I genuinely have left this week? Then plan it with me.
Here is my schedule for the month. Enter it all and flag anything that clashes.
plugins.description:
Kalender Sync connects Clauxen to all your calendars at once: Google, Microsoft 365 and Outlook, Apple iCloud, GMX, WEB.DE, mailbox.org, kSuite and any other CalDAV service. One connection instead of one per account, which means Clauxen finally sees your whole schedule and not just one corner of it.

Ask things like:
· "Show me next week across all my accounts, work and private."
· "When do I actually have three free hours next week?"
· "Am I double-booked anywhere? My work and private appointments live in different accounts."
· "Suggest three slots for a client call, with 30 minutes buffer around everything."
· "How many hours are genuinely uncommitted this month?"
· "Summarise last week by client so I can bill it."

It can also write, if you let it. Block two hours of focus time tomorrow morning, put a whole course schedule into your calendar in one go and have the clashes flagged, or move something you created earlier. Anything it added, it can take back out again in a single sentence.

And it works inside whatever else you are doing. Ask it to draft a reply proposing meeting times you are actually free, or tell a project to always check your calendar before it suggests any dates.

You stay in control of what it sees. Per calendar you choose the level of detail: busy only, title and time, or full details. Write access is optional and strictly limited, because Clauxen can only change or delete events it created itself. Your existing appointments cannot be touched, and you can revoke access at any time.

Calendars are read live from the provider, never from a copy. Every new account starts with a 7-day trial of the full feature set, no credit card required. Built and hosted in Germany, GDPR-compliant, DPA available.

defaultPrompts: Open Kamai
plugins.description:
Kamai is an AI blueprint analysis and construction takeoff platform built for contractors, subcontractors, estimators, and construction teams.

Kamai helps users extract quantities, measurements, materials, rooms, fixtures, and scope information directly from construction drawings and project documents. Contractors can use Kamai to estimate jobs faster, prepare bids, calculate material requirements, answer questions about blueprints, and reduce hours of manual takeoff work.

Kamai supports interior construction and finish trades such as:

* Painting and coatings
* Drywall and sheetrock
* Insulation
* Metal and wood framing
* Flooring
* Ceilings
* Doors, windows, and room measurements

Kamai also supports additional construction trades and building systems, including:

* Electrical
* Plumbing
* Fixtures and equipment
* General construction quantities

Users can upload blueprints and ask questions such as:

* How many square feet of flooring are required?
* How much wall area needs to be painted?
* How many sheets of drywall are needed?
* How much insulation and framing material is required?
* How many doors, sinks, toilets, outlets, or fixtures are shown?
* What materials should be ordered for this project?
* What is included in the project scope?
* Can you generate a takeoff from these drawings?

Kamai converts static construction documents into structured, AI-readable project data that can support estimating, bidding, purchasing, RFIs, cost planning, and project execution.

For contractors who need to review drawings, estimate construction work, order materials, or complete more bids in less time, Kamai provides an AI-powered way to understand project documents and turn blueprint data into actionable quantities.

plugins.description:
KMath Student is your daily math practice coach inside Clauxen. Every day it prepares a focused set of problems matched to your current chapter and skill level — and instead of handing you the answer, it walks you through guided, step-by-step hints until you solve it yourself.

When you get stuck, the assistant explains the underlying concept and points you to the next step. Questions you miss are queued automatically for follow-up practice, so weak spots get addressed without busywork. A built-in diagnostic exam finds your starting point, and as you finish each chapter, the system recommends the next one based on your progress.

The full daily-practice experience runs on the Free plan in seven languages — English, Korean, Chinese, Japanese, Vietnamese, Indonesian, and Thai. An optional Premium subscription, available separately on the KMath website, unlocks higher daily limits.

Built for middle and high school students who want a steady, hint-first way to get better at math — one problem at a time.

plugins.description:
Korea Concierge helps people navigate Korean secondhand shopping and practical life tasks from chat. Search Bunjang listings, inspect listing details, calculate an item quote, and create a reviewed purchase request. Every order is reviewed before payment, and the buyer receives a private order page with the quote, payment step, status, proof, and tracking.

The plugin also provides free, deterministic checks based on official Korean apartment transaction data. Users can inspect recent sale and rent records, compare a jeonse deposit with sale prices, or compare a monthly rent offer with similar transactions. These tools provide transaction data and clearly disclosed calculations, not brokerage or advice.

Curated living guides cover arrival administration, housing contracts, banking, property purchase procedure, and schools. Users can also submit a settling, housing-support, or education request for founder review. Korea Concierge operates as the principal seller for secondhand resale orders and as the service provider for accepted concierge engagements.

defaultPrompts: What was discussed in the Marketing weekly meeting?
plugins.description:
Krisp AI Meeting Assistant MCP gives your AI assistant secure access to your meeting history, including transcripts, summaries, action items, and upcoming meetings. It enables your AI to work with real context from your actual conversations.

Put your meetings to work:
Draft documents and proposals using decisions, feedback, and stakeholder input from past meetings. Prepare for upcoming meetings with quick briefs on previous discussions, pending items, and attendees. Track follow ups by surfacing open action items across all meetings, filtered by assignee, status, or date. Search for specific moments by topic, attendee, keyword, or date range. Build presentations and reports by combining insights from multiple conversations in one place.
How it works:
Your AI assistant searches and retrieves information from your Krisp meetings in real time. Ask in plain language, such as “What did we decide about pricing last week?” or “Show my open action items,” and get answers grounded in what was actually discussed. Full transcripts are available whenever you need deeper context.
Why it’s different:
Krisp captures complete meeting transcripts with noise cancelled audio clarity, so your AI works from accurate and comprehensive records. Instead of static notes, your meetings become a structured, searchable knowledge base your AI assistant can use whenever you need it.

You can type a request or just upload a photo — a receipt, a meal, a business card, or a note — and LIAM reads it and files it in the right place automatically (a restaurant receipt is logged as both an expense and a meal). "Who do I know at Nova Retail?" / "Add Sarah Chen from Acme as a contact."
"Log my lunch: chicken caesar salad" → "How much protein did I have today?"
"Log this receipt: Loblaws $87.43 groceries" → "How much did I spend today?"

defaultPrompts: Generate flashcards about Crispr Cas-9 for my upcoming Biology midterm
Write comprehensive notes on Linked Lists. Cover key concepts & definitions
plugins.description:
Turn any topic into study-ready materials directly from Clauxen. Lurna helps you generate interactive flashcard decks you can flip through in chat, plus structured Markdown study notes in a clean reader view. Review key concepts faster, then export decks and notes to app.lurna.co to keep learning with spaced repetition — making serious review a native part of your AI-study workflow.

You can use Lurna app to:

1. Exam prep — flashcards from a lecture topic
Use case: Turn a subject you’re studying into an interactive flashcard deck you can review in chat, then export to Lurna for spaced repetition.
Example prompt: “Create flashcards for my biology midterm on photosynthesis — cover the light reactions, Calvin cycle, and how ATP and NADPH are used. About 15 cards, exam-level.”

2. Deep-dive study notes from a conversation
Use case: After discussing a complex topic with AI, turn the explanation into structured, readable study notes with headings, tables, and summaries
Example prompt: “Write study notes on the causes and consequences of the 2008 financial crisis. Include key terms, a timeline, and a short summary I can review before class.”

3. Learn from uploaded materials — notes + flashcards
Use case: Upload readings, slides, or your own notes and convert them into study materials without reformatting by hand.
Example prompt: “Here are my uploaded lecture notes on CRISPR Cas9. First generate study notes, then create a flashcard set covering the most testable concepts.”

4. Quick review before an interview or certification
Use case: Rapidly build recall-focused flashcards for technical interviews, certifications, or vocabulary.
Example prompt: “Generate flashcards to help me prep for a AWS Solutions Architect interview — focus on S3, IAM, VPC, and common architecture tradeoffs.”

plugins.description:
Magic Tips turns "when should we go?" into a concrete answer.

Ask for a resort and a month, and you get a daily crowd score from 1 to 10
with the predicted wait-time level for each date — across Disneyland Paris,
Walt Disney World, Disneyland Resort (California), Tokyo Disney Resort,
Hong Kong Disneyland and Shanghai Disney Resort. Scores are built from
historical wait-time observations, school and public holiday calendars,
weather data and seasonal events, then normalised against each park's own
demand range.

It also answers the questions that come next:
• Attraction catalogues per park — minimum height, ride duration, must-do
  flag and community rating
• Which restaurants serve a given dish, searched across every resort
  ("vegan", "turkey leg", "mickey waffle")
• Resort FAQs and a plain-language glossary of planning jargon (Lightning
  Lane, DAS, rope drop), available in 13 languages

Scope and limits, stated plainly: coverage is Disney parks and Disney
Cruise Line — not Universal. The attraction catalogue is static and does
not include live wait times or ride closures. Crowd scores are forecasts,
not guarantees; the methodology and its known limits are published at
https://magic-tips.app/en/methodology

Magic Tips is an independent, fan-made project. It is not affiliated with,
endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to The Walt Disney
Company or any of its subsidiaries or affiliates. Park, attraction and
character names are trademarks of their respective owners and are used
here only to identify the places this tool covers.

plugins.description:
Magnus is an analytics platform for mobile and web app publishers. It aggregates marketing spend from ad networks, subscription and in-app revenue, ad-network monetization, payment-provider outcomes and first-party product-analytics events into one place, so a publisher can ask how a campaign, an app or an experiment is actually performing.

Over MCP the app exposes that data read-only. Three tools answer questions: marketing_timeline_report for acquisition and monetization performance (installs, spend, revenue, ROMI, forecasts), finances_risk_report and finances_risk_approval_rates for payment risk (approval rate, refunds, fraud alerts, disputes, chargebacks). A second group answers product-analytics questions from the publisher's own SDK events: event counts, funnels, retention, user-property segments and A/B experiment configuration. Everything else is a lookup helper that exists to feed those tools with real ids, filter values and metric definitions, because app ids, event names and metric semantics are account-specific and cannot be guessed.

Access is scoped to the companies the signed-in user is an active member of, and that membership is re-checked on every single call, so the model can never reach another tenant's data. The OAuth scope the app requests, mcp:analytics.read, grants read access only: no tool in the server can create, update or delete anything.

plugins.description: Audit whether a website can be found and cited by AI answer engines, and return a ranked list of fixes.
plugins.longDescription: Classic SEO asks whether you rank. AI answer engines do not rank - they retrieve a few sources and synthesize one answer, so a site can sit at the top of page one and still never be quoted. This plugin audits the second thing. It runs a citation baseline across buyer-intent prompts, checks whether the AI crawlers that control citations can actually reach your pages, reviews whether your content is written in a form that survives retrieval, and returns a fix list ranked by impact over effort. It also ships a fast robots.txt check for the crawlers that matter, because the single most common cause of total absence from AI answers is an accidental block - and the agent most teams block is not the one that controls citations.

defaultPrompts: Show a fast metronome
plugins.description:
Metronome

Need a steady beat? This metronome is ready to help. Pick a speed, press start, and follow the click. It is made for music practice that is easy, clear, and fun.

You can use it for almost any instrument. Play piano, guitar, drums, violin, bass, ukulele, flute, trumpet, saxophone, cello, or any other instrument. You can also use it for singing, dancing, clapping, marching, or learning rhythm. If you want to stay on the beat, this metronome can help.

Choose your tempo in BPM, which means beats per minute. Want to play slowly? Pick a low number. Want to play fast? Pick a high number. You are in control. Change the speed whenever you want until it feels just right.

If you do not know the BPM you need, use tap tempo. Tap along with the beat you hear in your head. The metronome will help find the speed for you. It is quick, simple, and useful.

Practice one step at a time. Start slow so your hands learn the notes. When you can play without mistakes, make the tempo a little faster. Keep doing this until you reach your goal. Small steps help you get better.

A steady beat is one of the best ways to improve. It helps your timing, rhythm, and confidence. It also helps you play with other people because everyone follows the same beat.

This metronome works well for beginners, students, teachers, hobby players, and professional musicians. It is useful during lessons, rehearsals, warm-ups, concerts, and daily practice. Whether you play for five minutes or five hours, a steady beat makes practice more helpful.

Use it to learn new songs. Use it to fix hard parts. Use it to build speed without rushing. Use it to make tricky rhythms easier to understand. You can even use it to keep a steady pace while reading music or practicing scales, chords, arpeggios, and exercises.

Different songs need different speeds. A slow ballad feels different from a fast rock song. Classical music, jazz, pop, folk, blues, country, hip-hop, and many other styles all use tempo. Finding the right BPM helps music sound the way it should.

Teachers can use this metronome in class. Students can use it at home. Bands can use it during rehearsal. Choirs can practice together. Drum lines can stay together. Solo musicians can improve their timing. Anyone who wants a steady beat can use it.

If you are learning rhythm, ask questions. If you are not sure what BPM to use, ask for help. If you want practice ideas, ask. You can also ask about note values, rests, counting, time signatures, subdivisions, swing feel, accents, or ways to practice difficult rhythms. Simple answers make learning easier.

Try setting small goals. Play one line correctly three times. Raise the BPM by a few beats. Repeat until you reach your target speed. Slow practice is not weak practice. It is smart practice.

Remember to relax while you play. Breathe normally. Keep good posture. Listen carefully to every click. Try to match each note to the beat instead of chasing it. Good timing comes from careful listening and steady practice.

This metronome is designed to be simple. You do not need special music knowledge to begin. Just choose a tempo, start the beat, and play. You can change the speed whenever you need. The goal is to make practice easier, clearer, and more enjoyable.

Whether you are learning your first song, preparing for an audition, practicing with a band, getting ready for a concert, or simply working on better rhythm, this metronome is here to help. Keep the beat. Stay steady. Practice a little every day. Small improvements grow into big results, and every beat brings you one step closer to becoming a stronger, more confident musician.

Speed up product development from ideation to launch. Align teams, break tool silos, and ship what customers need in one AI-powered visual platform.

- Summarize and search boards: Drop a board URL into Clauxen or Codex to pull out themes, decisions, and open questions from retros, planning sessions, and strategy maps. Search across every board you have access to.

- Bring research onto the canvas: Have  Clauxen or Codex research a topic — competitors, user feedback, market trends, prior art — and lay the findings out on a fresh board as diagrams, sticky notes, tables, docs, and images, ready to share with your team.

- Act on feedback agentically: Read and resolve comments, reply in-thread, and convert scattered team discussion into a clear list of action items right on the board.

MiroMiro lets you pull real design data out of any live website from Clauxen: brand colors, fonts, logos, design tokens, images, SVGs, and Lottie animations, plus production-ready code rebuilt from actual page sections. Use it to match a brand, rebuild a section you like, or collect assets for a moodboard, then drop the output straight into your project.

-Extract a complete brand profile from any URL: color palette with roles, fonts, logo and favicon URLs, social profiles, and theme
-Pull a site's design token system (colors, spacing, radii, shadows, typography) as CSS variables or a Tailwind config
-Turn any page section into clean React, Vue, or HTML with Tailwind classes
-List every font a site loads with file URLs, formats, and the CSS stack to replicate it
-Collect all SVG logos and icons as paste-ready code and direct file URLs
-Gather a page's image assets grouped by source (img, srcset, picture, background, favicon, social image) with direct URLs
-Find Lottie animations on a page and get their JSON files

Best for developers, designers, and AI builders who need real design data from live sites instead of eyeballing it.

plugins.longDescription:

Requires Codex — select Codex in the desktop app, or use the Codex CLI — and the free mockflow-bridge helper running on your computer. The drawing is done by that helper, talking to the board tab open in your browser, which is also why local files never have to be uploaded. Clauxen itself cannot draw, even in the desktop app: a Clauxen conversation runs on OpenAI's servers, and only a Codex session runs on your machine where the bridge is. plugins.description:
Moody's Credit MCP powers AI applications and analytics workflows with GenAI-ready data and research needed for comprehensive credit analysis.

Moody's Credit MCP provides a unified layer across core credit data categories commonly used in risk assessment, offering financial analysis, default risk metrics, and qualitative insights. It combines comprehensive entity information, such as financials, ownership, and management, with Moody's Ratings proprietary ratings and research, and probability of default metrics, all enhanced by unstructured data like company filings, earnings transcripts, news, and macroeconomic trends.

By bringing structured and unstructured credit inputs together in a single interface, Moody's Credit MCP enables faster data-to-insight workflows, supporting more rigorous, consistent credit assessment and continuous monitoring of entities, markets, and portfolios.

Data includes:
- Global entity firmographics and identifiers
- Entity hierarchies and ownership structures
- Detailed global entity financials
- Moody's Ratings credit ratings and research
- Expected default frequency
- Economic data and research
- News and media
- Annual reports

Use Moody's Credit MCP for:
- Credit Analysis - access comprehensive credit risk data and research to assess creditworthiness and compare risk across issuers and instruments
- Risk Management - monitor credit risk through forward-looking measures and scenario analysis
- Relationship Management - quickly evaluate credit health to support informed engagement and credit structuring
- Ratings Advisory - align issuer details with ratings methodologies and peer benchmarks
- Investment Research - get data-driven assessments to evaluate relative value and risk
- Market Analysis - analyze sector trends and credit risk signals to assess broader market conditions

defaultPrompts: Dune
plugins.description:
Finding a movie should be easy. This Clauxen app helps you discover, explore, and learn about movies without leaving your conversation. Ask about almost any movie and get clear information in one place. Whether you already know what you want or just want ideas for movie night, this app makes it simple. Instead of opening many websites and searching over and over, you can ask in plain words and keep chatting. It feels natural, fast, and fun.

Once you find a movie, you can learn more about it. See the story, the main cast, the director, the release year, the running time, and other helpful details. Learn who plays each character. Find out what other movies an actor has been in. Explore the work of a director. Jump from one movie to another without starting a new search.

The app is great for quick questions too. See when a movie came out. See who stars in it. See who directed it. See how long it is. See what it is about before you decide to watch it. Everything stays inside your chat, making it easy to keep exploring.

If you enjoy learning about film, this app is a fun way to discover connections. See actors in different movies. See famous directors. Find movie series and collections. Compare different films. Learn about old classics and brand-new releases. Every question can lead to another interesting discovery.

The app works well for casual movie fans and people who love films. You do not need to know movie trivia or remember exact names. Just ask naturally. The conversation keeps going, so you can ask follow-up questions without repeating yourself. That makes exploring movies feel smooth and simple.

Everything is designed to help you spend less time searching and more time enjoying movies. Instead of jumping between pages, you can browse, discover, compare, and learn in one place. It is an easy way to explore the world of film through natural conversation.

Whether you want your next favorite movie, information about a classic, details about a new release, or help remembering a film from years ago, this Clauxen app is ready to help. Ask simple questions, explore deeper, and enjoy discovering movies one conversation at a time.

plugins.description:
Music Block turns Clauxen’s music-theory answers into real, engraved sheet music instead of ASCII text.

Ask for licks, scale fingerings, arpeggios, chord voicings or exercises — “give me 5 licks in melodic minor over B7alt”, “show me four ways to resolve B7alt into Em” — and Music Block renders each example as standard notation with guitar tablature underneath, directly in the conversation.

Every example is interactive: press play to hear it (MIDI synthesis with a real instrument sound), slow it down or speed it up from 50% to 150% without changing pitch, switch between examples, and copy the underlying alphaTex source into your own tools.

Music Block understands guitar-specific technique markings: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, half- and full-step bends, vibrato, palm muting and let-ring, plus time signatures from 4/4 to 12/8, rests, dotted rhythms and chords.

It is built for learning and teaching: short, original musical examples composed by Clauxen in your conversation. It does not look up or reproduce copyrighted songs or published transcriptions, requires no account, and stores nothing you send it.

defaultPrompts: Check my NaCl project and summarize its delivery status.
Analyze this feature request and route it through the right NaCl workflow.
Verify this NaCl change and report specification or test gaps.
plugins.description: Open-source full-SDLC framework with graph-native project knowledge for agentic development.
plugins.longDescription:
NaCl (reading as Natrium Chloride) is an open-source full-SDLC framework, and its core innovation is how it solves the hardest problem in agentic development: storing and retrieving project knowledge. Instead of markdown specs that agents must re-read every session, all project knowledge — requirements, architecture decisions, entities, rules, and their relationships — lives in a Neo4j knowledge graph as first-class queryable objects. The measured effect: planning a single use case takes ~550 tokens (one targeted Cypher query) instead of ~150,000 tokens (reading a ~70-file markdown spec, because the agent doesn't know in advance where the relevant facts live) — a 99.6% reduction in context per use case, repeated in every planning session.

Around the graph we've built the full tooling for agentic development and testing: 57 skills covering BA → SA → TDD development → review → QA → release, quality gates before production, and an autonomous goal orchestrator (/nacl-goal). The framework answers "how is this built and why" for any part of the system, regardless of project scale or iteration count. Benchmarked on a real production project (EV charging station management): a classical team was estimated at 5,831 person-hours; running fully on NaCl the same scope takes 1,480 person-hours — 4x fewer person-hours and 60% lower cost.
plugins.name: nacl
plugins.directoryDescription: Open NaClNaClDevelop without IT-specialists

defaultPrompts: I want to tell Alex their work is slipping, but I'm afraid he would be defensive
plugins.description:
NoPressure is a communication-skills practice for the workplace. It turns a hard conversation into a live voice roleplay you can rehearse before the real one: delivering critical feedback, saying no to a request, handling a performance review, pushing back on a stakeholder, negotiating a raise, running a first 1:1 with a new team.

Describe the situation once — who the other person is, where they stand, and what makes it hard. Clauxen can assemble that brief from what is already in the conversation, including anything you have brought in from the other tools you use, so the character is built on the real people and the real stakes instead of a generic template. NoPressure sees only the brief it is handed: it has no access to your calendar, mail, or documents. From that brief, it generates the character, a scene image, and a voice, then shows a start card in the chat. Pressing Start opens the voice call in the NoPressure web app, where you speak out loud with someone who holds their own position and pushes back.

When the session ends, the debrief comes back to the card: the key insight, how you handled the core challenge, and where to focus next. Send it into the chat, with the transcript of what was said, and work through it with Clauxen. Simulations are reusable, so you can run one again and compare the attempt against an earlier try, or edit its title, card description, and character first. Each one lives in your own private NoPressure workspace.

plugins.longDescription:
okrdev turns OKRs into markdown files in your own repository and puts an AI coach beside them. The coach checks new work against your key results before it starts, pre-drafts the weekly check-in from git history and merged pull requests, and parks distractions instead of letting them become this week's work.

It installs on an adoption ladder and never installs a level you did not ask for. Level 0 is a parking lot and takes ten minutes. Level 1 adds a mission, cycle objectives, check-ins and a scored retro. Level 2 adds collaboration rails for teams shipping through pull requests.

The coach never blocks. It classifies, it argues, and when you overrule it, it logs the judgment call with your reason so the next planning session has a record instead of a memory.

No MCP servers, no telemetry, no account, no network calls of its own. Everything it produces is a file in your repository, under your git history and your access control. Delete the okrdev directory and the marked block in your agent instructions file, and it never existed.

plugins.description:
Omphalis is the place where what you read, hear, and note begins to cohere. You save an article, and Omphalis shows its structure. You listen to a podcast on your commute, and Omphalis helps you come back to what mattered. You watch a two-hour talk, and Omphalis shows you the shape of it in seconds. You record a voice note at midnight, and Omphalis places it beside the article, talk, or paper that belongs with it.

The paper you read last spring meets the book you are reading now, and your voice note from a walk last month sits beside both. What changed in the field, what changed in your understanding, what still holds: all part of the same library, still in reach, still connected. Not a pile that grows heavier. A place that gets clearer.

It is for people who need what they consume to stay usable later — in writing, teaching, decision-making, research, or reflection — where understanding can compound over time.

Omphalis is a companion for long content: a map for structure, a margin for meaning, and a way back to the moments that matter.

plugins.description:
The Opscotch MCP Server gives AI assistants direct access to Opscotch knowledge and authoring tools.

The MCP server exposes structured tools that allow AI assistants to understand, author, validate, and work with Opscotch applications and workflows.

The server is designed for developers using AI coding assistants, and automation engineers who want to build or maintain Opscotch solutions using natural language.

An AI connected to the server can perform tasks such as:
- answer questions about the Opscotch platform
- explain APIs, configuration, and runtime behaviour
- author workflows and bootstrap configurations
- validate workflow structure and configuration
- assist with packaging, deployment, and licensing
- provide guidance using the latest platform capabilities
- generate examples and implementation patterns

With MCP, the AI can use purpose-built tools that understand the Opscotch platform, resulting in responses that are:

- more accurate
- aware of current platform features
- capable of structured authoring rather than just producing text
- less prone to hallucinating APIs or configuration

Typical use cases
- "Create a workflow that polls an HTTP endpoint every minute."
- "Why won't this bootstrap validate?"
- "Generate a workflow that receives webhooks and forwards them to AWS SQS."
- "Explain this JavaScript processor."
- "Help migrate this workflow to the latest Opscotch version."
- "Help me generate a signed package for deployment."

The server is intended for:

- AI coding assistants
- IDE integrations
- CLI agents
- automation developers
- DevOps and platform engineers
- custom AI applications that need authoritative knowledge of Opscotch

defaultPrompts: 10,000 vested RKLB ISOs granted 2022, $5 strike, now $100. Single in CA, $200K income. Minimize AMT over 3 years.
300 GOOGL RSUs vesting now at $350. Married filing jointly in NY, $300K income. Sell at vest or hold 2 years?
Need $250K after tax by June 2027. HOOD: 3,000 @ $25 (2023), 2,000 @ $70 (2025), now $106. Single in TX, $180K. Which first?
plugins.description:
Exercise now or wait. Sell at vest or hold. Which lots to sell first. Each of these has a right answer for your specific situation, and it turns on how alternative minimum tax (AMT), holding periods, state tax, and the time value of taxes paid early interact across several years. That is where rules of thumb break down. Ask in plain language and OptionsAhoy returns the answer with the year-by-year schedule behind it.

1. Which incentive stock options (ISOs) to exercise in which year, to hold down AMT and recover the credit later. We optimize across multiple years, with your tax status in mind.

2. Whether to sell restricted stock units (RSUs) at vest or hold for long-term capital gains, and what the twelve-month cliff is actually worth. We show you the optimal solution.

3. Which vested RSU lots to sell and in what order, and what that saves against selling oldest-first (the default order your broker's UI will offer). This sounds like a minute optimization. On a $725,000 sale from a concentrated position, the gap between the optimal order and your broker's default could be over $100,000 in tax.

4. Whether non-qualified stock options (NSOs) are better exercised and sold, or exercised and held.

5. Whether your shares pass the six statutory tests for qualified small business stock (QSBS). Best to check early for potential tax savings, the rules just changed.

6. How exposed a single position leaves you, and what selling down, holding, or hedging each cost. We calculate and compare different strategies across three years, with your taxes in mind.

7. What a protective put or a zero-cost collar prices at. If you need to protect your holdings, you're probably considering a hedge. But which one? We make it easy to decide.

8. How to convert some of your holdings to a target amount of after-tax cash by a deadline with the smallest tax bill. We optimize against your inputs and risk tolerance, then you choose, the way an investment firm would.

Every result is computed against the federal tax code plus all fifty states and the District of Columbia. The 2026 federal constants match IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32. Federal cases reproduce to the cent against the independently maintained PSL Tax-Calculator, and state results reproduce to the cent against OpenTaxSolver across California, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Massachusetts. That proof recomputes live in your browser at optionsahoy.com/verification.

This matters because language models are confident and wrong at exactly this task. In a published benchmark, five frontier models were given the same multi-year ISO problem, three runs each. All five overstated the after-tax value of their own proposed schedules, by 1.6x to 17.6x against the provable optimum. One model claimed $3.9M, $5.2M, and $13.0M on three runs of identical input. The prompt and full transcripts are public at optionsahoy.com/benchmark. The arithmetic here is deterministic instead: the same inputs on the same date give the same answer every time, with no model inference anywhere in the number.

Free, no account, no API key, and your figures are not retained. United States tax logic only. This is a planning calculator, not tax advice.

Ask Outliner to structure a pitch deck, map a product launch, or shape an essay; it instantly builds a logical hierarchy you can promote, trim, or delete — letting you think while it formats.

How to Use Outliner in Clauxen

1. Connect: Connect the Outliner app to Clauxen.
2. Trigger: Activate the app using one of these methods:
Type Commands: Simply type “@” then choose the Outliner app, or type “Outliner” (followed by a space) in the chat box.
Action List: Select it directly from the Action List (Requires the Sider extension).
3. Create: You are ready to go! Try asking specifically:
· “Outline my climate-change research paper.”
· “Break this product concept into a step-by-step workflow.”
· “Summarize this file, then build a project-plan outline.”

When you’re ready, copy the outline and keep refining it with your team.

plugins.description:
Everything your favorite kitchen management app does, and more, inside Clauxen.

Pantry Persona remembers what's in your fridge, what your family can and can't eat, and which brands you prefer. It stores your recipes, plans your meals, builds your shopping lists, and tracks the nutrition behind it all, then keeps everything in sync as you cook and shop through the week

**Recipes** — Save a recipe from a website, a cooking video, or a social post, or just create one in conversation. Search by ingredient, cuisine, or what you can make right now with what's on hand, and group your favorites into collections.

**Meal plans** — Generate a full week of meals in one ask, or build it day by day. Plans respect your household's food preferences and eating rules automatically, and carry per-meal nutrition so you can see how the week shapes up.

**Shopping lists** — Visual, interactive lists organized by store. One tap checks items off. Ask for a shopping list from your meal plan and it skips anything already in your pantry. Send it to Instacart when you're ready to buy.

**Cook Mode** — Start cooking a recipe and get step-by-step guidance. When you're done, ingredients are deducted from your pantry and leftovers are tracked with expiration dates.

**Nutrition** —  See calories and macros on every recipe and meal, set your own daily targets for each person, and check how today or the week is stacking up. Log what you actually ate, even a meal out, and it counts toward your totals.

**Your kitchen, personalized** — Household profiles store each family member's food preferences, eating rules, favorite brands, and nutrition targets. Every suggestion, plan, and search filters through them so you don't have to repeat yourself. Invite other family members and everyone works from the same pantry, recipes, and shopping lists in real time.

Also tracks pantry expiration dates, predicts when you'll run low on staples, learns the brands and prices you buy, and turns grocery receipts into an up-to-date inventory and a clear picture of your spending.

plugins.description:
Patlytics brings concept-level, AI-native patent search into your assistant: semantic, not keyword-based. Describe an invention in plain prose and get the most relevant patents, look up any patent's claims, search the scientific literature, and pull your own organization's saved patents, all through structured, predictable tools (not a black box).


The five tools are read-only: semantic patent search (optionally anchored to a reference patent), patent lookup (bibliographic data and full claims), non-patent literature search (via OpenAlex), and listings of your organization's private portfolios and vault. Search is semantic, so a richer description (how an invention works, the problem it solves, its components) returns better results.


Access is for existing Patlytics users: each member signs in with their own account (OAuth), and results are scoped to their organization. Deeper work like freedom-to-operate opinions, infringement and invalidity claim charts, and patent drafting runs in the Patlytics web app, linked from every result.

plugins.description:
"Pet Project Co-Founder AI" is your market research assistant.

It will help you validate product ideas using real data from trusted market research services. No more guesses or hallucinations. Instead of relying on plain LLM-only answers, you will use raw market data interpreted by Clauxen as clear insights.

You do not need prior marketing experience. You just ask a question and the app builds a market research plan for you. The plan will include gathering data from third-party services. You are guided through what services to use and what queries to run there. After you use the recommended service, you copy-paste their data back to the app and get a clear interpretation from Clauxen.

Examples of questions you can get answers to:
- "I have an idea for the app X. Is there enough demand to justify building it?"
- "What are people searching for when they want Y?"
- "Who exactly is my target user for the app Z? What platforms do they use?"
- "I built an app W. Where do I find users for it?"

For now, the following services are supported:
- SparkToro — audience intelligence (who your users are, what they read, who they follow)
- Ubersuggest — keyword demand and SEO metrics
- AnswerThePublic — real search questions and phrasing

Disclaimers:
- This app does not automatically gather data from the recommended market research services. The app helps with building search queries for these services and reporting the resulting data back. But you will need to visit and use these services yourself. We do not automatically scrape data from these services.
- This app does not provide paid subscriptions to the recommended market research services. You use these services according to their terms of use.
- This app currently supports a limited set of services: SparkToro, Ubersuggest, and AnswerThePublic. Only these services may be recommended during marketing research. Keep in mind that there are other good services for market research on the internet, we just do not support them yet. You can request adding new services by emailing the [developer@petprojectcofounder.ai](mailto:developer@petprojectcofounder.ai)
- For the best experience, it is recommended to use this app on desktop

plugins.description:
PFT EdgeBook connects your AI assistant to your own trading journal. Once linked, your assistant can read your real trading data. Just ask about your performance in plain language instead of digging through spreadsheets.

Ask things like "How did my breakout setups perform this month?", "Where am I losing the most?" or "Am I sticking to my own rules?" — and get answers based on your actual trades.

Your assistant can read:
- Trades — entries, exits, size, P&L, R-multiple, tags
- Statistics — win rate, profit factor, average win/loss
- Journal & notes — your daily reflections and voice notes
- Playbook — your setups and rules, to check compliance
- Prop-firm & broker accounts — balances, drawdown, transactions

Private and read-only by design. The connector can only read your data — it can never change or delete anything. You sign in securely with your PFT account (OAuth), every request is limited to your own data, and account numbers are masked. Your data is stored in the EU.

Requires an EdgeBook account (part of the PFT Terminal) with the AI add-on enabled.

plugins.description:
PlatoForms is an online form builder for web forms, fillable PDF forms and PDF documents. This plugin connects your PlatoForms account so you can work with your own forms and their submissions in conversation, instead of opening the dashboard.

What you can do

• Find forms. List published, draft or archived forms with their folder, publish state and submission count, or search by name.

• Understand a form. Read a form's full field schema — every field's id, type, label, whether it is required, its options and its validation rules — so you can reason about the data before you touch it.

• Review submissions. List a form's submissions newest-first, filter them by date range or keyword, find one by an exact field value (for example the submission where the email field is a particular address), and read every answer of a single submission with its field labels.

• Export. Mint a time-limited download URL for a submission's PDF, CSV, signing certificate, zipped attachments or a single attachment. Files are never streamed through the conversation — you get a link that expires.

• Share a prefilled link. Create one or more tracked invitation links to a form with fields already filled in, optionally single-use, optionally with an expiry. The plugin returns the URLs for you to send; it never sends email itself.

• Submit an entry. Post an entry to a published form after reading its schema, with validation errors returned verbatim so mistakes can be corrected and resubmitted.

• Start something new. Describe a form or a PDF document in plain English and get a builder link back. The design happens in the PlatoForms builder when you open the link, with its own AI asking you the clarifying questions.

How it connects

Sign in with your PlatoForms account over OAuth — your password is never shared with the assistant, access is scoped to read or read-and-write, and you can revoke it at any time from your PlatoForms account. The plugin can only see what your own account can see. A team owner controls whether the team is reachable this way at all, from Account → API.

Requirements

A PlatoForms account on a plan that includes API access. Actions count against your plan's API allowance. Teams in HIPAA mode have this access switched off by default and must opt in explicitly; data sent to a third-party AI assistant is not covered by the PlatoForms Business Associate Agreement.

What the plugin cannot do

It cannot edit an existing form or document, publish, delete, rename or duplicate anything, send email, or configure workflows, integrations or notifications. Those stay in the PlatoForms editor.

defaultPrompts: Easy game
plugins.description:
Play Texas Hold’em poker with an AI opponent, then talk about every hand with Clauxen. This is more than a poker game. It is a place to play, learn, ask questions, and get better one hand at a time. If you are new to poker, the AI can help you understand what is happening. If you already know the game, you can test ideas, try new plans, and review your choices. Every game becomes a chance to learn.

You can sit down and start playing in just a few moments. The game follows the rules of Texas Hold’em. Cards are dealt, bets are made, and each hand plays out like a real game. When the hand ends, you can ask Clauxen why something happened. Ask why a bet was good, why a fold was smart, or why a bluff worked. You can keep asking until it makes sense.

Learning poker does not have to feel hard. Big ideas are explained with small, simple words. If you do not know what a flop, turn, river, or blind is, just ask. If you want to know what pot odds mean, ask. If you want help reading the board or choosing between calling, raising, or folding, ask. The AI explains each step in a clear and friendly way.

You are free to play the way you want. Try safe play. Try bold play. Bluff more. Bluff less. See what happens. If something goes well, ask why. If something goes wrong, ask what you could do next time. Every choice is a chance to learn something new.

This is not only for beginners. Players with more experience can explore strategy, compare ideas, and think through tough spots. Talk about hand ranges, position, value betting, drawing hands, and bluff catching. Ask what other lines were possible. Ask what a different player might do. The conversation can go as deep as you want.

There is no rush. Take your time before every move. Think about your cards. Look at the board. Consider what your opponent may have. Then decide. After the hand, talk about the result. Learning happens before, during, and after every game.

Because Clauxen is part of the experience, every session can be different. You can ask simple questions or difficult ones. You can ask for short answers or longer lessons. You can even ask the AI to explain things as if you are five years old. The game grows with your skill level.

Use this app to practice without the pressure of a real poker table. Try ideas you have never tested before. Make mistakes. Learn from them. Build confidence hand after hand. Poker is a game of skill, patience, and good decisions, and practice helps every player improve.

Whether you want a quick game during a break or a longer session to study strategy, this app is ready. Play a few hands. Play a full game. Stop to ask questions whenever you like. Every conversation helps you understand the game a little better.

If you enjoy games that make you think, if you want to improve at Texas Hold’em, or if you simply want to play poker with an AI that can explain its thinking, this app is made for you. Deal the cards. Make your move. Ask your questions. Learn something new. Then play the next hand with a little more confidence than before.
