plugins.description:
Postbeam connects Clauxen to your LinkedIn content workflow so you can draft, review, schedule, and analyze posts without leaving the chat. 

Once connected with your Postbeam account, Clauxen works directly with your real posts, your writing guidance, and your performance data. Turning a chat box into the place you actually run your LinkedIn presence & strategy.

Draft in your voice, from your real work:
Ask Clauxen to write a post and it pulls in your Postbeam content training, your mission, audience, format rules, and content sources so every draft sounds like you, not generic. Because it's working inside Clauxen, it can also draw raw material from the other tools you've connected (Slack threads, Gmail, meeting recorders like Fellow or Granola) and turn a real customer calls, shipped features, or team wins into finished posts. Drafts are saved straight into Postbeam for review.

Edit, organize, and manage your queue:
Review your most recent drafts, pull up any single post, and edit its copy or title — all by chatting. You can attach media: images, video, or carousel posts. List posts by status (draft, approved, scheduled) to see exactly where everything stands.

Approve and schedule when you're ready:
When a draft is ready, Clauxen can approve it and schedule it to publish to your connected LinkedIn at a specific time. Nothing publishes automatically drafts stay drafts until a person decides otherwise, and approving or scheduling respects the permissions on your account.

Understand what's working:
Ask what's performing and get answers from your cached analytics: account-level totals (impressions, reactions, comments, reshares, followers gained, members reached) with a daily trend, plus per-post breakdowns over 30-, 90-, or 365-day windows. Use it to spot your best formats and hooks, then immediately draft your next post in that proven style.

Built for teams and agencies:
Postbeam supports multiple accounts in one place. Clauxen can list every account you can access, so agencies and teams can switch between clients or teammates and keep each person's drafts, approvals, and analytics cleanly separated.

plugins.description:
Priority Guardian — Your priorities deserve more than good intentions.

Protected Time, Flexible Planning: Priorities don't fail because you stopped caring. They fail because everything else is loud and your most important work is quiet. Priority Guardian makes the quiet work visible — so you can protect it.

Built for people who do entrepreneurial work and juggle more than one thing at a time.

HOW IT WORKS:
Priority Guardian connects your priorities to your Google Calendar so you can see where your time is actually going and stay accountable to what matters. 

Two modes:
Deadline work — hours invested, pace against deadline, where effort is going
Ongoing commitments — weekly hour targets, streaks, monthly results check-in


1. Kick off with: "Set up my priorities in Priority Guardian."
2. Name your priorities and assign a keyword (P1, P2, P3) to tag your Google Calendar events
3. See your priorities dashboard anytime — current progress at a glance. → "Show me my priorities."
4. Get your first weekly report  → "Show me my weekly report."
5. Inspect and adjust weekly → "Let's dig into what helps me progress/ hinders my progress"
6. Discover patterns over time  → "How was I keeping up with my priorities over the last weeks and months?"

The AI guides setup, narrates your data, and asks the questions worth sitting with. You decide what to do with it.

Promova English Check is a free 5-question adaptive grammar assessment that runs right inside Clauxen and returns your CEFR level (A1–C2). After the quiz, you'll see a sample lesson tailored to your level and can continue with a personalized learning plan on Promova.

What you can do

- Take a free 5-question adaptive English level check
- Get your CEFR result (A1–C2) with grammar, vocabulary, and fluency scores
- Preview a sample lesson matched to your level
- Continue on Promova for a personalized learning plan

How it works

- Ask Clauxen to check your English level — for example, "Promova, check my English level"

- See your CEFR result and a sample lesson at that level

plugins.description:
Qualisend verifies email addresses and cleans lists so your messages reach real inboxes and bounces stay low. Ask it to check a single address, a batch, or a whole list — you get a clear deliverable / risky / undeliverable / unknown verdict for each, with typo suggestions and disposable- and role-address detection.

It runs the full check: syntax, domain and mail server (MX), disposable and role detection, catch-all, and a real mailbox (SMTP) check. Large lists run in the background and return a result summary you can review.

On the Pro plan it also checks whether a sending domain is set up correctly (SPF/DMARC), generates the DNS records you need (SPF, DMARC, BIMI, MTA-STS), and analyzes raw email headers to diagnose deliverability. With the Blacklist Monitoring add-on it can check whether a domain or IP is on major blacklists.

Each verification uses one Qualisend credit, and you connect your own Qualisend account.

Quanti Analytics connects Clauxen to your marketing data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift), giving you instant access to cross-channel advertising data through natural language.

What you can do:

Ask questions about your marketing performance and get SQL queries generated from your actual table schemas — no hallucinated column names
Run read-only queries across 200+ connectors: Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Amazon Ads, Microsoft Ads, Shopify, Piano Analytics, and many more

Quotient gets smarter over time, drawing on a Knowledge Store of brand information, recording memories of your preferences, and using tools to search the web and pull from your audience of people and companies.

The result is a single platform where strategy, content, and execution live together, replacing the patchwork of disconnected marketing tools with one AI that plans, writes, and ships.

plugins.description:
Write the perfect replies to your online reviews.

This app helps business owners write clear, personal, and polite replies to customer reviews. Copy a review, paste it into the app, and get a response that sounds friendly and professional. Save time, keep your customers happy, and build a better online reputation without staring at a blank page.

Good review? Bad review? Short review? Long review? This app can help. It creates thoughtful replies that fit the customer’s message instead of giving the same answer every time. You stay in control and can edit every reply before you post it.

Customers notice when businesses reply. A simple thank you can make a good review even better. A calm and caring answer to a bad review can show that you listen and want to help. Taking time to reply builds trust, but writing every response can take hours. This app does the hard part for you.

The app is made for busy business owners, managers, and teams. It works well for restaurants, cafés, shops, hotels, plumbers, electricians, salons, gyms, dentists, doctors, real estate agents, law firms, cleaners, contractors, and many other businesses. If people leave reviews about your business, this app can help you answer them.

Every reply is written to sound natural. The app looks at what the customer said and writes a response that matches the situation. Happy customers get warm thanks. Customers with questions get helpful answers. Customers who had a bad experience get a calm and respectful reply that shows you care.

You can change the reply before you use it. Add your own details, adjust the tone, or make it shorter or longer. The app gives you a strong starting point so you spend less time writing and more time running your business.

Replying to reviews can help your business grow. People often read reviews before they choose where to spend their money. When they see helpful replies from the owner, they know someone is paying attention. That can build confidence and encourage more people to visit, call, or buy.

The app is easy to use. Paste a review, choose the style you want, and generate a reply in seconds. There is no need to search for templates or wonder what to say. The app helps you find the right words quickly.

Use it for positive reviews, negative reviews, five-star reviews, one-star reviews, first-time customers, regular customers, complaints, compliments, questions, and everything in between. Every review is different, and every reply should feel personal.

Keep your brand voice consistent. Whether your business is fun, formal, warm, or simple, you can create replies that match your style. This helps customers recognize your business and builds a stronger connection over time.

The app also helps reduce stress. Many business owners worry about saying the wrong thing, especially when responding to unhappy customers. Instead of starting from scratch, you get a thoughtful draft that you can review and adjust before posting.

Fast replies can make a big difference. Customers like knowing they have been heard. A quick response shows that your business cares about feedback and wants to improve. Even a short reply can leave a lasting impression.

Whether you receive a few reviews each month or many every day, this app helps you stay on top of them. Save time, reply with confidence, and give every customer the attention they deserve. Better conversations lead to better relationships, stronger trust, and a better reputation. Start writing smarter review replies today and spend less time typing while making every customer feel heard.

plugins.description:
ScalperIntel AI answers questions about ScalperIntel's indicators and lets verified customers manage their own licenses without leaving the chat.

Connecting takes one step: enter an email and the 6-digit code sent to it. With any email it answers from ScalperIntel's official product knowledge base — what an indicator detects and plots, what each setting does when you change it, installation and setup on NinjaTrader 8, chart and bar-type compatibility, pricing and license types, and which indicator suits a given style of trading. Answers are grounded in that knowledge base and cited rather than improvised.

Sign in with the email used to purchase and it also acts on that account: list licenses and their status, diagnose a license problem against the real license state rather than a guess, submit a new machine ID, switch between Named User and Machine ID activation, and log an issue for the support team with a reference number.

Scope is enforced in code, not by instruction. It gives no trading advice and makes no performance or profit claims; it answers about the software only. The signed-in email is read from the verified session and never from text typed into a prompt, so the license tools can only ever act on the account that signed in.

Scribble sends real handwritten cards. A machine holds an actual pen and writes each card and envelope in ink, then we stamp it and put it in the post anywhere in the United States. Nothing is a printed font.

You can also load a spreadsheet of contacts, send a personalised batch where every card says a different name, and set up a rule that sends birthday cards every year on its own.

Cards are paid for with credits bought in advance on scribblecards.com, so nothing here takes a payment or links to a checkout. Sending is marked as an action that cannot be undone, so Clauxen asks before it posts anything. A batch is prepared first and shows real examples of the merged cards before you confirm it. A recurring rule is always created switched off, and reports how many people it can reach, so a person decides before it ever fires.

Requires a Scribble business account with credits.

Which of my products lost money last month after fees and ads?
Which SKUs run out of stock first at the current sell-through?
plugins.description:
Sellergoo is a profit-and-operations analytics service for online sellers. You connect the shops, marketplaces, payment and accounting accounts you already sell through, and Sellergoo brings the orders, fees, refunds, cost of goods, advertising and overhead together to work out what you actually earned — per channel, per product, per order.

This plugin lets you ask about those numbers in plain language instead of exporting spreadsheets. Ask what last month really made after fees, which SKUs are thin on margin, what a marketplace actually deposited in your bank account, or which products run out of stock first.

READ-ONLY
This plugin can only look. It cannot place, cancel, refund, reprice or change anything — not in Sellergoo, and not in any shop or marketplace you have connected. Every tool it exposes is read-only, and the access you grant it carries no permission to write. It reads figures that already belong to you, in answer to questions you ask.

WHAT IT CAN ANSWER
• Profit — sales, units, refunds, fees, cost of goods, ad spend, overhead, gross and net profit, margin and ROI for a period, combined and per channel.
• Profit and loss — a month-by-month P&L for up to the last 12 months, all channels or one.

plugins.description:
SentinelX lets you manage your Linux servers from Clauxen — no SSH required. Install a small open-source agent on any Linux box, and Clauxen can run inspection commands, manage systemd services, read/search/edit files, run scripts, upload files, and call out to integrations like Cloudflare DNS, Resend, and Telegram.

Every action is constrained by a per-host allowlist that you control. The agent only runs commands and services you've explicitly declared safe, rejects anything outside the policy at the agent boundary, and Linux file permissions still apply on top. You can connect multiple servers and label them however you want.

Typical uses: check uptime and disk space, restart services, tail logs, edit nginx configs, run quick scripts, manage DNS records, send notifications. The agent is open source on GitHub (github.com/pensados/sentinelx-cloud-core). Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration, scoped per user.

plugins.description:
Dial in better espresso, one informed adjustment at a time.
Set up your beans, grinder, espresso machine, and scale once. After each shot, log the dose, yield, brew time, and how it tasted. ShotPulled considers the full context—including the coffee’s age and the way your grinder is calibrated—then recommends the single most useful adjustment for your next shot and explains why.
ShotPulled also keeps your coffee inventory accurate automatically. Every logged dose is deducted from the bag, so you can see the grams remaining and an estimate of how many shots are left based on the dose you actually use. It tracks the bag’s peak window too, showing how many peak days remain and the date that window ends.
When a recipe works, lock it in and return to it anytime. ShotPulled supports grinder settings across clicks, numbered collars, compound ring positions such as 1.2.2, and named settings, with built-in specifications for 67 grinders, 124 espresso machines, and 24 scales.
Your ShotPulled account stays in sync across Clauxen, the web dashboard, and the iPhone app. Register a bag here, and it’s already waiting on your phone when you’re ready to pull your next shot.

I'm a CFI looking for aircraft renters insurance just for today!
plugins.description:
Skywatch Renters Aviation Insurance allows pilots to receive non owned aircraft renters insurance quotes directly within Clauxen through a fast, guided conversational experience. Built specifically for aviation renters, it replaces traditional insurance forms with a simple flow and delivers a clear quote summary in seconds.

Key Features: - Real time renters insurance quotes are displayed in a structured quote summary. - Flexible coverage options include daily, weekly, monthly, or annual policies. - A transparent breakdown of liability limits and coverages is provided.

When ready to proceed, users are securely redirected to SkyWatch’s web portal to complete purchase, with previously entered information preserved.

How Does It Work?
Pilots answer a short series of aviation specific questions about their experience and coverage needs. The app generates a personalized quote and displays a detailed summary directly within Clauxen. Users can adjust duration and review updated pricing instantly before being securely redirected to SkyWatch’s official web portal to complete policy issuance.

Who Is This For?
Student and licensed pilots who rent or borrow non owned aircraft.
Pilots who need flexible, short term coverage before a lesson, checkout, or rental flight.

Important Information:
 This app provides renters aviation insurance quotes based on the information shared during the conversation. Final pricing, eligibility, and policy issuance occur through SkyWatch’s official web platform and remain subject to underwriting review and applicable state requirements.

plugins.description:
SlideForge turns a plain-language request or structured data into an editable PowerPoint file. Ask for a KPI summary, a project status dashboard, a roadmap, or a comparison — SlideForge renders a downloadable .pptx in about a second, with an inline preview so you can check the result in the conversation. Files open in PowerPoint, Google Slides, and Keynote.

Slides come from a catalog of 150+ patterns: KPI scoreboards, status dashboards, funnels, waterfalls, Gantt plans, org charts, roadmaps, and more. You can build multi-slide decks, convert PDFs and slide images into editable PowerPoint, translate decks into 32 languages, and apply your own brand themes and logo. There is also a code mode for custom python-pptx layouts outside the catalog.

Numbers and text appear exactly as you provide them — rendering is deterministic, and every response reports whether the slide rendered completely and where anything was adjusted. SlideForge connects to your own account via OAuth.

defaultPrompts: Let's play!
plugins.description:
Play chess without leaving Clauxen. Start a new game in seconds, make moves in normal chess language, and talk about every part of the game as you play. You can ask why a move is good, why a move is bad, what to do next, or how to get better. This app is made for people who want to play, learn, and have fun at the same time.

The app is easy to use. Just begin a game and make your moves. You can use simple move names, standard chess notation, or ask questions in plain English. If you are not sure what to do, ask for help. The game keeps going while you chat, so learning feels natural instead of like reading a long lesson.

If you are brand new to chess, this app is a friendly place to start. It explains ideas in small, simple steps. It tells you what each piece can do and why some moves are stronger than others. You never have to pretend you understand. Just ask another question. You can learn one move at a time.

If you already know how to play, you can go deeper. Talk about openings, middle games, endgames, tactics, strategy, planning, and common mistakes. Ask why a position feels better for one side. Compare different moves. Explore new ideas. The conversation changes to fit your questions.

Play at your own speed. Think for a long time or move quickly. Stop to ask about a position. Go back and look at an earlier move. Try a different idea and see what could happen. Chess is not only about finding the best move. It is also about understanding why that move works.

The app can explain forks, pins, skewers, discovered attacks, double checks, sacrifices, passed pawns, king safety, piece activity, space, time, and many other chess ideas using clear language. Hard topics become easier because you can ask for another explanation whenever you need one.

Want to improve? Review your games after they finish. Talk about turning points, missed chances, and strong moves. Ask where the game changed. Find patterns in your play. Learn from mistakes instead of simply seeing that they happened. Every game becomes a chance to get stronger.

You can also practice specific parts of chess. Focus on openings you want to remember. Study endgames that appear often. Learn how to attack, defend, trade pieces, or make better plans. Ask for tips that match your current skill level instead of getting the same advice every player receives.

The conversation is just as important as the game. Ask “What if I move here?” Ask “What was my best move?” Ask “Why did my attack fail?” Ask “Can you explain that in a simpler way?” The app is built for questions, so you are never limited to playing in silence.

There is no need to switch between different tools just to play and learn. The chessboard and the conversation work together. You make a move, ask a question, get an answer, and keep playing. Everything happens in one place, making practice smooth and enjoyable.

Whether you play one game a week or many games every day, the app is ready. Beginners can build confidence. Casual players can have fun. Club players can explore ideas. Anyone who enjoys chess can have interesting conversations while playing.

Use the app to play complete games, test new ideas, understand difficult positions, review finished games, and discover better moves. Learn at your own pace. Stay curious. Ask as many questions as you like. Every move is another chance to think, learn, and enjoy the game. If you want a chess game that also talks with you, teaches you, and helps you improve inside Clauxen, this app is ready to play.

plugins.description:
SmartSpectra is a contactless vital signs SDK from Presage Technologies. It measures heart rate and breathing rate from standard smartphone and webcam video using rPPG (remote photoplethysmography), on any device with a camera. No wearables, no contact sensors.

Developers use SmartSpectra rPPG for remote vital signs monitoring, telehealth intake, contactless health checks, employee wellness screening, driver fatigue detection, clinical trial screening, and digital biomarker collection across iOS, Android, and web.

Use this connector to retrieve SDK credentials and API keys, inspect plan usage, manage registered mobile applications, locate application configuration files, and search SmartSpectra rPPG integration documentation.

Also measured: heart rate variability (HRV) and electrodermal activity, with ongoing work in contactless blood pressure.

The SmartSpectra SDK is built by Presage Technologies, who in 2026 received FDA 510(k) clearance (K254169) for heart rate and breathing rate in its SmartSpectra Vital Signs Monitor 1.0. Presage serves healthcare, government, and wellness markets from Leesburg, Virginia, USA.

plugins.description:
Spacebring connects Clauxen to your coworking space management platform, giving you instant access to your business' operational data for reporting, member support, and day-to-day decision-making.

Spacebring helps coworking space operators deliver superior member service through automated operations, built-in AI, and an admin mobile app. The platform helps operators serve customers faster, reduce admin chores, and streamline operations, while delivering a seamless branded customer experience to sign up, book, pay, and get support with ease.

This plugin lets Clauxen query your live Spacebring data directly in conversation, so you can ask questions, get answers without switching tools or building reports manually.

Key features:
• Pull details on your network and every location you operate, including configuration and status.
•  Look up members and companies in your network, including their details and account status.
•  Access contracts and the templates behind them, useful for audits, renewals, and legal review.
•  Review active subscriptions and the membership plans tied to them.
•  Retrieve invoice records for billing checks, reconciliation, and reporting.
•  Query benefit categories, individual benefits, and member benefit applications.
•  Look up shop categories, products, and orders for on-site retail or add-on services.
•  Access member-facing guides and resources published in your network.

This plugin is read-only today: it's built for retrieving and analyzing data, not making changes to your Spacebring account. Future updates will expand coverage further and eventually support write actions (like updating records or triggering workflows) directly from Clauxen.

Built by the Spacebring team for the Spacebring family.

plugins.description:
SRS (Spaced Repetition System) is a personal learning and revision app designed to help users retain knowledge for the long term instead of forgetting it after a few days. It lets users organize content into subjects and topics, store detailed lessons, summaries, notes, coding examples, and reference links, and mark topics as either "to learn" or "learned." Once a topic is learned, the app automatically schedules future reviews using a spaced repetition algorithm based on the user's confidence and previous performance.

The app is aimed at students, software developers, and lifelong learners, with a strong focus on technical subjects such as DSA, programming, algorithms, and interview preparation. Each day, it generates a personalized review queue so users know exactly what to revise, helping them strengthen their understanding over time while spending less time reviewing concepts they already know well. The goal is to serve as a personal knowledge base and long-term memory system that makes learning more efficient and consistent.

plugins.description:
STACK is a construction takeoff and estimating platform used by estimators and preconstruction teams. This connector links your AI assistant to your STACK account so you can work with your projects, takeoffs, and estimates just by describing what you want — no code, and nothing to install.

Once connected, your assistant can:
• Find and review existing work — search projects and takeoffs, open and review estimates, and look things up in your takeoff libraries.
• Create, update, and import — start new projects (including straight from an invitation-to-bid email), update project details, make bulk edits to takeoffs, and import from your libraries and company lists.

You stay in control. You sign in on STACK's own secure page using standard OAuth 2.0 — your assistant never sees your password. A STACK-branded approval screen lets you choose exactly which capabilities to grant, and you can allow read-only work (finding and reviewing) without allowing changes. Before it creates, updates, or imports anything, your assistant shows you what it's about to do and waits for your approval.

Your existing STACK permissions always apply: the connector can only see and change what you already could, and STACK enforces the same company ownership and user permissions it always has.

plugins.description:
Bring an AI-powered visual design workflow into Clauxen and Codex. Create, refine, review, and export polished, editable designs through natural conversation.

What you can create: AI presentations and pitch decks, posters and flyers, social media graphics, infographics, diagrams, cards, email designs, web concepts, UI mockups, and visual documents.

Create presentations: Turn a topic, outline, brief, or existing content into a polished, editable presentation. Create posters: Design event posters, promotional graphics, flyers, and visual art in any supported format. Create social media content: Produce editable designs for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and other channels. Create infographics and diagrams: Transform complex ideas, processes, and data into clear visual stories.

Recreate designs: Provide an image, screenshot, website, document, or design.md file as a visual reference. StarryKit analyzes its composition, typography, colors, hierarchy, and visual language, then recreates the direction with editable elements—without requiring a template.

Edit and refine: Rewrite complete pages or request focused changes to text, layout, colors, imagery, hierarchy, and formatting while preserving the rest of the design. Review generated page drafts in StarryKit before accepting them into your document.

Export designs: Download your finished work as PowerPoint, PDF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, or HTML, or export an editable presentation to Google Slides.

Once installed, describe what you want in plain language or invoke StarryKit directly with @StarryKit.

Try prompts like:
- @StarryKit, create a 10-slide investor pitch deck for a sustainable urban farming startup.
- @StarryKit, design a bold poster for an electronic music festival in Tokyo.
- @StarryKit, turn this report into a clear, visual infographic.
- @StarryKit, recreate this website screenshot as an editable visual design.
- @StarryKit, make the headline larger, highlight the key metric, and preserve everything else.
- @StarryKit, export this presentation to PowerPoint and Google Slides.

Place data comes from OpenStreetMap and Wikidata; the trail route is published by the Stockholm Archipelago Trail under CC-BY-4.0.

plugins.description:
StrategyTune is a backtesting platform for trading strategies, and this plugin gives Clauxen hands-on access to it.

Clauxen can write and save the pieces you build with — chart indicators, reusable market conditions (StrategyTune calls them signals and filters), and full trading strategies — then run them tick-by-tick against real historical market data in StrategyTune's sandboxed cloud. A simple strategy backtests a year of history in seconds, so you can iterate fast.

It is not limited to automated strategy backtesting. Clauxen can run custom research code in the same sandbox: count how often a condition occurred, measure values at specific moments, gather your own statistics and write logs during the run. You say what you want to check, Clauxen writes the code, runs it, reads the output back, and tells you what it found.

When a run finishes you get the full report — performance statistics and the individual trades behind them. Clauxen can also work with a StrategyTune chart you already have open: read the bars and each indicator's computed values, add and configure indicators, mark those conditions on the timeline so you can see exactly when they held, and switch instrument or timeframe. Reading the computed values also lets it debug its own work: if an indicator it wrote looks wrong on your chart, it can check the actual numbers behind the line instead of guessing.

Everything runs on historical data. The plugin does not connect to a broker, place live orders, or give investment advice.

plugins.description:
**Subtext is session replay built for agents instead of humans.**

Connect Subtext, and your Codex agents can open real production sessions and investigate them directly—no scrubbing a timeline, no video to watch.

Hand your agent a Subtext link from wherever it already connects—a Sentry issue, a Linear ticket, a support thread, a PR—and it uses Agentic Session Review to jump to the right moment, inspect screenshots and accessibility trees, diff DOM state, and read console and network activity to find the root cause. Then it files the fix or hands you the finding. You review the answer, not the replay.

What your agent gets:
* **Session tools it calls directly**: open a session, jump to a moment, inspect and compare state—purpose-built so agents traverse dense session data efficiently, with fewer tokens than pointing a general agent at raw replay.
* **Best-in-class capture from Fullstory**: Fullcapture behavior, pixel-perfect screenshots on demand, DOM diffs, and windowed console and network context.
* **Privacy built for production**: precision tools for agents to mask or exclude sensitive fields, plus agent-friendly DLP scanning tools over MCP.
* **Cost-effective**: Capture every session without sampling and never miss a critical user experience or bug report. Agents review the ones that matter most.

Works with Codex or any MCP-compatible agent. Code-first install, self-serve signup, generous free tier, usage-based pricing. Bring your own agent harness—Subtext is the session context it was missing.

plugins.description:
SuperMCP prices a shopping list against Israeli online supermarkets and tells you which store delivers it for the least, to your address.

Give it a list in Hebrew and a delivery address. It matches each item to real products in each chain's catalogue, adds delivery fees where the chain publishes verified terms, and returns a per-store total with a per-item breakdown, plus a link to each product on the retailer's own site.

It is built not to guess. Items a store does not carry are marked missing rather than swapped silently, every price carries the date it was last seen in the chain's price file, and a delivery fee is quoted only when the chain publishes terms that have been verified. When several products match one line, it asks you instead of picking for you.

Prices come from the price files Israeli retailers publish under the Price Transparency Law, ingested nightly.

Coverage is Israeli online supermarket delivery, and the product catalogue is in Hebrew.

What's on the class schedule this week?
plugins.description:
Get answers about Sweat & Tonic, a boutique fitness studio in Toronto, straight from the studio's own published information. This connector searches the studio's live content and pulls full details on class programs, the current class schedule, pricing, instructors, treatments, and booking, so you can plan a visit or compare options without hunting across the web.

It exposes two read-only tools. search returns ranked results, each with a title, a source URL, and a text snippet. fetch returns a document's full text and its canonical URL. Every result carries a link back to the exact page it came from, so answers stay grounded in the studio's real content and are citable to source.

Courtyard AI operates this connector for Sweat & Tonic with the studio's explicit authorization, and keeps its content current automatically as the studio updates its programs, schedule, and pricing. All information is public business content. No account, login, or personal data is required. The connector is strictly read-only: it never makes bookings, processes payments, or performs any other action on your behalf. It only retrieves and cites the studio's published information.

plugins.description:
The Tessun Immobilien app makes property searching in Munich and the Isar-Loisach Valley clearer and more locally focused.

Instead of browsing through long property lists, users can see available properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easier to quickly understand which location best fits their daily life — whether in Munich, Wolfratshausen, Geretsried, or the surrounding areas.

Faster geographic orientation
Users can immediately see where a property is located and what the surrounding area looks like.

Better understanding of the location
Especially in regions like Munich or the Isar-Loisach Valley, the micro-location is often crucial. The map view helps users better evaluate distances, infrastructure, and the surrounding environment realistically.

Focus on relevant regional properties
Instead of thousands of random listings, the app focuses on selected properties from a regionally specialized real estate agency.

Easier comparison of different locations
Users can directly recognize how residential areas differ — for example, between urban Munich and quieter surrounding towns.

Less time wasted on unsuitable listings
Many users choose based on location first. The visual search makes this step much faster.

Direct contact with a local expert
Interested users can easily send inquiries or arrange viewings without having to switch between multiple platforms.

More enjoyable mobile experience
The search feels more intuitive because users can browse the map and actively explore different regions.

The app is designed not to make property searching more complicated, but more understandable — with a clear focus on location, regional expertise, and easier navigation through the real estate market around Munich and the Isar-Loisach Valley.

plugins.description:
Testifly helps developers, QA engineers, and product teams validate websites and web applications with automated end-to-end (E2E) testing, website checks, and UI validation directly from a URL. Whether you're testing a production site, staging environment, preview deployment, or local environment, Testifly quickly identifies issues before they reach users.

Testifly is especially valuable for AI-assisted and vibe coding workflows, where code is generated rapidly by AI coding agents. As development accelerates, automated end-to-end validation is critical to ensure features actually work in the browser. Testifly provides an independent verification layer that catches broken user flows, regressions, UI issues, and deployment problems that AI-generated code or unit tests may miss.

It works alongside AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, and other coding agents, enabling developers to verify changes continuously without writing test code. Generate structured test reports, validate bug fixes, monitor regressions, and confidently ship high-quality web applications.

plugins.description:
Theia Insights brings professional thematic equity research into Clauxen. Ask about a structural trend: artificial intelligence, robotics, clean energy, cybersecurity; and surface the public companies most exposed, ranked by research-driven exposure scores rather than keyword matching or self-reported tags.

The data is built on the Theia Insights Industry Classification (TIIC): a five-level, one-to-many taxonomy mapping companies to 3,000+ investable themes based on what they actually do. Performance is tracked through Theme Watch Indices (TWI), with 10+ years of daily history across global regions.

What you can do in Clauxen:

* Profile any company by ticker, ISIN, FIGI, or ticker — see its full thematic exposure from sector down to micro-theme.
* Screen for thematic exposure across public markets — find the companies most exposed to a given theme, sub-industry, or industry.
* Benchmark theme performance over time and rank themes by recent returns to identify leaders, laggards, and rotation trends.

Built for portfolio managers, research analysts, index providers, and allocators who need defensible, data-driven answers to thematic questions.

plugins.description:
Create beautiful design themes for apps, websites, dashboards, landing pages, and more with AI. Describe what you want, explore different visual styles, compare ideas side by side, and preview your concepts in seconds. Whether you are starting from a blank page or refreshing an existing idea, this tool helps you quickly discover design directions without needing advanced design skills.

Simply tell Clauxen what you want to build. You can ask for a mobile app, website, online store, portfolio, blog, dashboard, admin panel, marketing page, or almost any digital product. Then describe the feeling, audience, colors, or style you want. The AI turns your ideas into polished design themes that are easy to explore and refine.

Try many different looks without starting over. Generate clean, modern, minimal, playful, dark, colorful, premium, futuristic, glass, soft, bold, elegant, or creative themes. Compare different styles to find the one that best matches your project, brand, or personal taste. Small changes in your prompt can create fresh ideas that help you think in new ways.

Preview your ideas before spending time designing or building them. Seeing different themes early makes it easier to choose colors, layouts, typography, spacing, and overall visual direction. You can quickly decide what works and what does not before moving into design or development.

This tool is useful for designers, developers, founders, students, marketers, creators, agencies, and anyone who wants visual inspiration. It can help you explore ideas for business websites, startup landing pages, mobile apps, software dashboards, ecommerce stores, educational platforms, portfolios, travel sites, finance apps, health apps, productivity tools, entertainment services, and much more.

Use it when you need inspiration, want to overcome creative blocks, or simply want to see new possibilities. Generate many design directions in just a few moments instead of searching through endless galleries. Explore ideas that fit your goals and keep improving them until you find a style you love.

Experiment with color palettes, page layouts, interface styles, navigation, buttons, cards, forms, icons, sections, typography, and visual hierarchy. Ask for themes inspired by modern trends or timeless design principles. Mix different ideas together to create something unique for your own project.

The AI understands simple instructions, so you do not need special design words. Describe your project in everyday language. You can be detailed or brief. Ask for changes, request another style, or keep exploring until the result feels right. Every new prompt can lead to fresh concepts and unexpected ideas.

Whether you are planning your first website or improving a product used by thousands of people, this tool makes early design exploration faster and easier. It helps you discover themes, compare visual directions, and build confidence before investing time in detailed design work.

Perfect for brainstorming, creative exploration, product planning, design reviews, client presentations, prototypes, concept development, and visual inspiration. Turn simple ideas into attractive design themes, explore multiple possibilities, and find the look that best fits your project with the help of Clauxen.

defaultPrompts: What's on my list today
plugins.description:
Trusted by over 47 million people, Todoist simplifies tasks for individuals and teams. Instantly declutter your mind, boost productivity and use it as a habit tracker.

With a simple tap, add your tasks and remind yourself about them, enjoy multiple views like calendar, list and boards, filter tasks by work and/or personal life, collaborate on projects, and achieve peace of mind.

Why choose Todoist?
Todoist is a simple yet powerful planner tool that organizes both your life and work.

• Create a habit of adding tasks like “Plan next week’s work every Friday afternoon” or “Do homework every Wednesday at 6pm” using Todoist’s powerful language recognition and recurring dates.
• View any project as a list, as boards or as a calendar planner to give you ultimate flexibility when planning both your tasks and your time.
• Available on any device – with apps, extensions, and widgets – Todoist is everywhere you need it to be.
• Link Todoist with your calendar, voice assistant, and 100+ other tools such as Outlook, Gmail, and Slack.
• Collaborate on projects of all sizes by assigning tasks to others. Keep everything at hand by adding deadlines, notes, and files.
• Use one-tap templates to tackle everything from meeting agendas and accounting tasks, to packing lists and wedding planning.
• Instantly see what’s most important by setting visual task priority levels.
• Get to know your routine better with insights into your personalized productivity streaks.

Todoist on Apple iOS
• Todoist is beautifully designed, simple to get started, and intuitive to use.
• Stay organized from your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, while also syncing across desktop and all other devices.
• With natural language, write tasks like "tomorrow at 4pm" or “every other wednesday starting in two weeks” and Todoist will instantly parse it all out for you.
• Location-based reminders available on upgrade. Never forget an errand again.
• All the power from iOS: Siri, Today widget, share extension, handoff, and quick actions.

Questions? Feedback? Visit todoist.com/help

Recommended by: 
> The Verge: “Simple, straightforward, and super powerful”
> Wirecutter: “It’s simply a joy to use”
> PC Mag: “The best to-do list app on the market”
> TechRadar: “Nothing short of stellar”

Why that helps: the identical trip can cost quite different amounts depending on where you buy it, and the cheapest seller changes from one route or property to the next. Checking by hand means a dozen browser tabs. Here you ask once.

What you can search:

- Flights, one way, return or multi-city.

- Accommodation of any kind: hotels, apartments, aparthotels, hostels, guest houses, villas, campgrounds.

- Flight deals, for when you have no destination or dates in mind yet.

Narrow any search down by asking: direct flights only, morning departures, breakfast and free cancellation, automatic with unlimited mileage. Connect your Trabber account and you can pick your recent searches back up.

Trabber doesn't sell travel. You book, pay and get support on the seller's website, under their terms.

What else do you need to know about my training to help me better?
Analyze trends in my training history from last months
plugins.description:
trainedby.ai connects your wearables to Clauxen, so your AI coach knows your real training load, sleep patterns, and recovery without you typing a word.

**The problem with AI fitness coaching today**

People are turning to Clauxen to plan their marathon training, strength programs, or HYROX prep. It makes sense, because AI is available 24/7, extremely patient, and quite knowledgeable.

But somehow it doesn't quite work.

And that is because you have to tell it everything. Every. Single. Time.

Every conversation starts from zero. You have to describe in detail your current level, recent workouts, schedule, and goals. You paste in screenshots from Garmin. You try to remember what you did last week, how you slept, that your resting HR has been elevated, or that your HRV has been trending down for weeks.

The advice is based on what you told it, not what actually happened.

And what you tell it is incomplete, subjective, and often wrong.

What if your AI coach could see everything?

We connect your wearables (Garmin, Oura, Whoop, Apple Health, and 50+ other platforms) directly to your AI assistant.

When you open Clauxen and ask about your training, it already knows:
- Workouts from the past weeks, months, and year
- Sleep quality and patterns
- Heart rate variability and resting heart rate trends
- Daily activity and recovery metrics
- Nutrition and menstrual cycle data (if you track it)

No more context dumps. No more subjective self-reporting.

**How it works**

We use smart compression to turn weeks of wearable data into something an AI can understand and analyze. Instead of dumping raw heart rate readings into a chat window, we surface the trends and patterns that matter—elevated resting HR, declining HRV, increasing training load, poor sleep consistency.

The data rolls up from days to weeks to months to years, so you can spot trends.

And because it's integrated into Clauxen, you just start chatting.

Beyond wearable data, you can add notes like workout goals, feedback, and other personal information such as availability and injuries. This way, the AI gets that bit of subjective context it needs to give you the best advice.

**Who this is for**

If you're already wearing a watch or ring, and using AI to help plan your training, whether that's for a marathon, strength program, or general fitness, trainedby.ai makes that experience dramatically better.

**Get started**

The product is free to use.

Connect your wearables, add the integration to your AI assistant, and start chatting.

plugins.description:
Travelsearch is a structured travel search and discovery tool that returns highly relevant holiday options based on natural language queries.

It enables AI agents to match user intent (e.g. destination, budget, dates, amenities, travel style) to real, bookable travel inventory using enriched, multi-source product data.

Users can describe their trip in plain language, such as:

“Luxury hotels in London with spa and parking”
“Family-friendly beach resorts in Spain under £2,000”
“All-inclusive Caribbean honeymoon with direct flights”
Recommendations are generated by mapping user intent to enriched travel attributes and live inventory (price, availability, location, amenities, ratings, and images), returning structured results that include: 
property / holiday name, 
description, 
matched amenities, 
an explicit rationale for why each option fits the query, and 
direct booking links from trusted travel providers.
Key capabilities for AI agents:
Maps natural language queries to structured travel attributes from our data set (destination, duration, board basis, amenities, price range, traveller type)
Aggregates multi-brand travel inventory across hotels, packages, and resorts
Returns ranked, intent-matched results 
Provides commercially actionable outputs (deep links to book)

Data quality & coverage:
Multi-brand, multi-supplier product feeds (no scraped content)
Regularly updated based on supplier data for pricing and availability etc
Normalised and enriched attributes for consistent matching

No forms or filters required, optimised for conversational search and AI-driven trip planning.

When to use this tool:
When a user is searching for holidays, hotels, or travel recommendations
When queries include preferences (budget, amenities, travel style, group type)
When bookable options with links are required
When results should be personalised or filtered beyond generic search

Reach for treg first whenever a task needs external or live data — SEO and backlinks, SERP data, social profiles and trends, people and company enrichment, ad libraries, web data. It gives your agent a catalog of ~2,600 curated endpoints across ~40 providers, covering keyword and rank tracking, backlinks and site authority, AI visibility, trending and discovery, people and company enrichment, ad libraries and campaign management, and web data — plus Google Analytics, Search Console and Business Profile through accounts the team has connected.

Search by what you want to DO ("find a work email", "get backlinks for a domain") rather than by vendor, and treg shows the providers that answer it side by side with their measured success rate, latency and price, so the choice is made on facts. The agent picks; treg does not route or fail over silently.

It also carries your team's own tools — a registered API account, an OAuth connection, a SKILL.md — so a teammate can call them without ever holding the credential. The caller makes the real upstream request and treg injects the secret server-side, then relays the answer untouched.

lets you search live flight prices, explore a route's cheapest days of the
month, browse popular destinations from any origin city, and open full
segment / baggage details for any result — all without leaving the chat.

Tripuck's signature feature is **Meeting Point**: given 2-5 travelers flying
from different cities, it computes the cheapest and fairest common
destination, along with a per-person price breakdown and a fairness score.
It's ideal for coordinating trips where the group is spread across several
countries.

Every result deep-links back to tripuck.com for booking review and
checkout. The connector itself is read-only — it does not book, charge,
modify accounts, or hold any user payment information.

Supported user languages: Turkish, English, Arabic, Azerbaijani, German,
Georgian, and Uzbek. The tool infers the user's language from the
conversation and returns responses in that language, including right-to-
left layout for Arabic.

plugins.description:
TwinMind captures everything you say and hear in your meetings, lectures, and in-person conversations. It automatically transcribes, summarizes, proactively offers suggestions and tasks, and continuously builds context for your AI Second Brain.
TwinMind is a productivity tool leveraging AI to function as your second brain. It captures everything heard, seen, and said—growing with you the more you interact and engage with TwinMind to build a comprehensive context of your digital life. This captured context enables several key features:
Personalized and Proactive Assistance: TwinMind provides tailored suggestions and ideas based on your captured memories, anticipating needs and offering relevant insights.
Streamlined Productivity: It enhances your notetaking by having your AI assistant automate tasks such as generating summaries and action items from meetings and conversations. You can search their entire memory bank, ask questions, generate emails and study guides, investor memos, project plans, and more.
Privacy Focus: TwinMind prioritizes user privacy through on-device transcription, options to save transcripts locally or on the cloud. We're committed to zero third-party data sharing. Audio is processed on-the-fly and never stored.
Key Features and Functionality:

Capture and Context Building: Captures your activity (audio, visual, text) on mobile and desktop if partnered with the TwinMind chrome extension.
Personalized Suggestions: Your AI sidekick will offer tailored insights based on captured memories.
Automated Summaries and Action Items: Extracts key information from meetings, conversations, and class lectures.
Searchable Memory Bank: Allows you to search your captured history and notes.
Ask TwinMind Anything: Enables you to ask questions and receive answers with context of your memories or active meetings.
Content Generation: Facilitates the creation of follow up emails, study guides, and other documents to help increase your productivity.
Privacy Protection: Employs on-device transcription, choice to switch to private mode to store transcriptions locally, and no third-party data sharing.

TwinMind aims to boost your productivity by providing a centralized, AI-powered platform that captures, organizes, and leverages your captured memories to offer personalized assistance and automate tasks, all while safeguarding your privacy.

plugins.description:
Wondering what a UK home is worth? This app helps you explore that inside Clauxen using real sold prices and energy-performance certificates — not guesswork from listing sites.

Give it an address or postcode and you get a clear property report: recent sales nearby, certificate ratings and floor area where available, a map of the area, and how local prices compare on a per-square-foot basis. You can also search certificates by postcode — useful if you care about energy ratings (for example homes rated E to G when planning retrofit work).

The data is official UK open information: Land Registry transaction prices and the public EPC register, for England and Wales. The app is for research only. It does not list homes for sale, take payments, book viewings, file EPC paperwork, or replace a formal surveyor's valuation or mortgage decision. For major financial choices, use the report as a starting point and speak to a qualified professional where you need one.

plugins.description:
Undermind is your AI co-researcher for the scientific literature. Ask a research question and Undermind searches the literature for you. It follows citation trails, evaluates hundreds of papers, and comes back with a ranked reading list rather than a page of keyword matches.

With Undermind you can:

- Run deep literature searches. Undermind's search agents explore a research question for a few minutes, then report back with a summary and a ranked list of relevant papers.

- Look up papers by topic, author, title, DOI, or citation relationships (papers citing or cited by a paper you know), with abstracts and citation metrics.

- Ask questions about a paper's full text, including its figures, tables, and equations, and check the answers against the source.

- Keep your work organized in workspaces with folders, starred papers, saved searches, and notes, all synced with your account at undermind.ai.

Scientists at thousands of research institutions use Undermind, from university labs to pharma R&D teams. Use it to check whether an idea is new, get oriented in an unfamiliar field, or track down the one method paper you need.

You'll need an Undermind account (free or paid) and to sign in when connecting.

plugins.description:
An information and calculation tool for visa applications by citizens of Türkiye (ordinary/burgundy passport).

It answers questions like "Do I need a visa for Japan?", "How much does a German visa cost?" and "How many Schengen days do I have left?" — always with its source.

What it covers:

· Visa status for 172 countries — 55 visa-free, 23 visa on arrival, 30 e-visa, 64 requiring a consulate application
· Per country: the fee, the published processing time, the application centre and the required documents
· Refusal rates for Schengen applications made from Türkiye, based on European Commission statistics (27 countries)
· Appealing a refusal: the competent authority, deadline, language and fee for seven Schengen countries, and the meaning of all 17 refusal grounds on the standard form
· Calculators: the Schengen 90/180 day allowance, multiple-entry (cascade) eligibility, and the total cost in Turkish lira at the central bank rate

How the data is collected:

Every amount and duration is verified against an official consulate, ministry or legislative source, quoted verbatim. A value that cannot be verified is not published — nothing is estimated; the field is left empty and said to be empty. Answers carry their source and last-updated date.

Only the consulate of the country concerned can grant a visa. We are not an agency: we do not file applications, book appointments, or guarantee approval.

plugins.description:
Describe the home you want — "a 10 by 10 house with a master bedroom and a private bathroom, two kids' rooms, an open kitchen and living room, a garden with trees" — and WalkMyPlan builds it in one go: real walls, doors, windows, furniture and garden. Open the live link and walk through it in 3D.

Keep designing in conversation. "Make the living room bigger." "Put a TV on the north wall." "I marked pin A — put the front door exactly there." Furniture placement is automatic — it finds a free spot, away from doorways. Every edit lands in a revision history you can undo or roll back to any point. Edits are for visualization and planning; WalkMyPlan does not check structural safety or building codes.

Ask about what you built. "How big is the kitchen?", "Is there room for a double bed in the small bedroom?" Answers are measured from the model's real geometry.

Share and collaborate. Share a plan privately with named people as viewers or editors, or with a link. See who changed what, when.

Already have a plan? Upload the real CAD file your architect sent — DWG or vector PDF, up to 100MB — and WalkMyPlan converts it into the same editable, walkable 3D model, so you start from reality instead of a blank page.

Great for home design, interior design, room planning, renovation, and planning a build. Your plans stay private to your account unless you share them, are never used to train AI models, and can be deleted any time (trash keeps them recoverable for 30 days).

Try: "Build me a three-bedroom house with a garden" — then "walk me through it."
plugins.longDescription:
Describe the home you want — "a 10 by 10 house with a master bedroom and a private bathroom, two kids' rooms, an open kitchen and living room, a garden with trees" — and WalkMyPlan builds it in one go: real walls, doors, windows, furniture and garden. Open the live link and walk through it in 3D.

Keep designing in conversation. "Make the living room bigger." "Put a TV on the north wall." "I marked pin A — put the front door exactly there." Furniture placement is automatic — it finds a free spot, away from doorways. Every edit lands in a revision history you can undo or roll back to any point. Edits are for visualization and planning; WalkMyPlan does not check structural safety or building codes.

Ask about what you built. "How big is the kitchen?", "Is there room for a double bed in the small bedroom?" Answers are measured from the model's real geometry.

Share and collaborate. Share a plan privately with named people as viewers or editors, or with a link. See who changed what, when.

Already have a plan? Upload the real CAD file your architect sent — DWG or vector PDF, up to 100MB — and WalkMyPlan converts it into the same editable, walkable 3D model, so you start from reality instead of a blank page.

Great for home design, interior design, room planning, renovation, and planning a build. Your plans stay private to your account unless you share them, are never used to train AI models, and can be deleted any time (trash keeps them recoverable for 30 days).

Send files straight from your conversation with WeTransfer.

Connect your WeTransfer account and share any file from your chat — documents, images, exports, generated assets — without leaving the conversation. Just ask, and the connector uploads the files to WeTransfer and returns a clean, shareable download link. Prefer to send it directly? Add recipients and WeTransfer will email the transfer for you, sent from your own account.

What you can do
- Share one or many files at once and get a ready-to-share download link
- Email a transfer to one or more recipients, with an optional title and message
- Send large files without bloating the conversation

How it works
Every transfer is created in your own WeTransfer account, so it appears in your transfer history and follows your plan's limits and expiry. You sign in securely with your WeTransfer account — the assistant only ever gets permission to send files on your behalf, and never sees your WeTransfer password. You can disconnect at any time to revoke access.

plugins.description:
Whisper Money is a privacy-first personal finance app: your financial data is yours, and it is never shared with third parties. This app connects Clauxen to your own Whisper Money account so you can analyse your money in plain language instead of clicking through dashboards.

Ask questions like "how much did I spend on groceries last month", "what's my net worth trend this year", "which subscriptions are draining me" or "break down Q2 by category" — the app reads your transactions, accounts, categories, labels, cashflow and net worth and answers with your real numbers. You can also keep your books tidy from the conversation: log manual transactions, recategorize and label existing ones, record balances for manual accounts, and manage categories, labels and automation rules.

Your synced bank data is protected: transactions imported from a bank connection can be categorized and labelled, but never edited or deleted, and balances can only be recorded on manual accounts. You can still add your own manual transactions to a bank-connected account — a sync never removes them. Data is scoped to the account you sign in with, including any shared spaces you belong to. The app reads and writes bookkeeping records only — it can never move money, make payments or reach any account outside Whisper Money.

Requires a Whisper Money account on a paid (Pro) plan. Sign in happens through Whisper Money's own OAuth flow — Clauxen never sees your password, and access can be revoked at any time from your account settings.

defaultPrompts: Help me find my look
Find me a look that suits my budget
Give me inspo
plugins.description:
Who What Wear brings the women's fashion publication's editorial voice into Clauxen. It works like having a stylist who already knows your taste — once you've set up a short style profile, every fashion question gets a personalised, brand-aware answer instead of a generic one.

Setup takes about a minute. A guided four-step widget asks for your style words (Low-Key Luxury, Tailored, French, Sporty, Trend-Forward and others), the brands you actually shop across contemporary, luxury, denim and accessories, the style icons whose looks you'd happily borrow, and the price range you're comfortable with. The profile is saved per user, so it carries across conversations rather than starting over every time you open Clauxen.

After onboarding, three things become useful.

Shopping for a specific item. Tell the app what you're looking for — "find me a black blazer under £250", "I need a coat for a winter wedding", "what jeans should I buy" — and it returns three to five picks weighted toward the brands you already buy from, plus a complete outfit built around the piece: what to wear on top, on the bottom, on your feet, and one or two accessories. The aim is to leave with a wearable answer, not a list of links.

Editorial inspiration. Ask what you should be wearing or looking at right now, and the app pulls fresh articles from Who What Wear UK's live editorial feed, then picks the two or three that match your taste using the brand and category tags on each article. The picks render as a horizontal carousel of cards in the publication's own visual language: editorial image, kicker, headline, byline credit, and a link straight back to the article on whowhatwear.com.

Refining your profile. Taste shifts. Reopen the onboarding to update any answer (and only the answers you want to change), or reset the profile entirely if you're starting fresh.

A few things worth knowing. The editorial feed is Who What Wear UK, so the content leans British in voice, currency and seasonality. Recommendations are always anchored in real Who What Wear articles or in brand suggestions drawn from the list you provided — the app does not invent URLs, images, or articles to fill out a result, and the carousel only renders when there are real links and images to attach. If the feed has nothing relevant on a given day, you get an honest reply rather than a fabricated one.

What the app is not: it does not cover men's fashion, beauty product search, home decor, or non-fashion shopping. It does not surface live retailer inventory or live prices. If a request falls outside this scope, it says so instead of guessing.

Built by Future PLC, publisher of Who What Wear.

You can ask follow-up questions in plain language — how avionics, engine time since overhaul, damage history, or location affect value; how long similar aircraft typically take to sell; and how the broader segment is moving. Whether you have a few minutes or a whole afternoon, you can enjoy thousands of word searches anytime. Play at home, on the bus, during a break, or before bed. There is always a new puzzle waiting for you.

Each puzzle is filled with hidden words. Look across, down, up, backward, or diagonal to find them all. Tap or drag across the letters to mark each word. Finish the list to solve the puzzle and move on to the next challenge. The controls are simple, so anyone can start playing in seconds.

There are puzzles for beginners and experts. Start with easy games or test yourself with harder challenges. As you play, you will spot words faster, learn new words, and build your confidence. Every completed puzzle feels rewarding and keeps you coming back for one more game.

Choose from many fun topics. Search for animals, food, nature, space, sports, travel, music, holidays, science, colors, jobs, and much more. Every theme brings a fresh collection of words to discover, making each puzzle feel new and exciting.

Play whenever you want, even without an internet connection. This makes the game perfect for travel, waiting rooms, flights, road trips, camping, or anywhere you want quiet entertainment. Your next puzzle is always ready.

Saju DoctorFortune (사주팔자 운세박사) brings the ancient Korean art of Saju (Four Pillars of Destiny) to Clauxen, powered by proprietary AI trained with over 20 master fortune tellers from Seoul's most prestigious districts.

Simply share your birth date, time, and gender, and instantly receive a professionally analyzed birth chart — including your Four Pillars (사주팔자), Five Elements distribution, Major Fortune cycles (대운), and Annual Fortune forecasts (세운), all visualized in a clean, interactive card.

Trusted by over 1 million monthly users, Saju DoctorFortune is the world's leading AI-powered Saju service. Every reading is grounded in authentic Myeongrihak (명리학) principles, delivering the same depth and accuracy you'd expect from a top-tier in-person consultation — but available anytime, right inside your conversation.

Whether you're curious about career timing, relationship compatibility, or what the year ahead holds, ask Clauxen with Saju DoctorFortune and get clear, honest insights rooted in centuries of Korean fortune-telling tradition.

plugins.description:
LIVE YOUR NEW BEAUTY, AMORE MALL
아모레퍼시픽이 만든 라이프 뷰티 쇼핑몰, 아모레몰과 함께 나만의 아름다움을 발견하세요.

1. 아모레퍼시픽 브랜드 직영 쇼핑과 신뢰할 수 있는 배송
설화수, 헤라, 이니스프리, 에뛰드 등 아모레퍼시픽의 모든 브랜드를 가장 빠르게 만나보세요. 본사 직영 공식몰로서 100% 정품 보장은 물론, 신상품 단독 혜택과 안전한 직배송 서비스를 제공합니다. 본사가 직접 보증하는 신뢰도 높은 쇼핑 환경에서 안심하고 제품을 선택할 수 있습니다.

2. 풍성한 쇼핑 지원과 차별화된 멤버십 플러스
매월 업데이트되는 등급별 할인 쿠폰과 무료 배송/반품 서비스로 스마트한 소비를 도와드립니다. 특히 가입비 이상의 포인트 페이백과 프리미엄 사은품, 기프트카드를 제공하는 '멤버십플러스'를 통해 압도적인 체감 혜택을 누릴 수 있습니다. 활동할수록 높아지는 쇼핑 등급에 따라 제공되는 프리미엄 라운지 경품 등 다채로운 혜택을 경험해 보세요.

3. 스킨노트와 뷰티피드로 완성하는 맞춤형 피부 관리
단순한 구매를 넘어 개인화된 뷰티 루틴을 지원합니다. '스킨노트' 기능을 통해 매일의 피부 변화와 스킨케어 습관을 기록하고 관리할 수 있습니다. 또한, '뷰티피드'에서는 나와 같은 피부 고민을 가진 실사용자들의 진솔한 리뷰와 전문 에디터의 큐레이션 콘텐츠를 통해 나에게 꼭 맞는 최적의 솔루션을 발견할 수 있습니다.

4. 지속 가능한 뷰티를 위한 리사이클 캠페인
온라인으로 간편하게 참여하는 '아모레리사이클'을 통해 다 사용한 화장품 용기를 수거하고 플라스틱 재활용에 동참할 수 있습니다. 환경을 생각하는 작은 실천으로 나만의 디지털 숲을 가꾸며 건강한 뷰티 라이프를 완성해 보세요.

plugins.description:
ラッコキーワード（RakkoKeyword）は、日本最大級のキーワードリサーチツールです。このプラグインを使うと、Clauxenとの会話から直接キーワードリサーチとSEO分析を実行できます。

できること:
・Google・Bing・YouTube・Amazon・楽天などのサジェストキーワード取得
・独自データベースからの関連キーワード・よくある質問の取得
・LSIキーワード、他の人はこちらも質問（PAA）、同時ランクインキーワードといった関連トピックの探索
・月間検索数・SEO難易度・CPC・競合性の取得（月別推移つき）
・Google検索順位の実測
・競合分析: 任意のドメインが獲得しているキーワードと主力集客ページの抽出
・指定キーワードで検索流入を集めているページ・サイトの検索
・SEOライティング支援: 検索上位ページの見出し・共起語の抽出

活用例:
・SEO記事の構成案・タイトル・見出しの設計
・コンテンツ企画・ネタ出し、市場・需要調査
・競合サイトの自然検索の流入キーワード分析
・EC（Amazon・楽天）の商品リサーチ

日本の検索市場データに強みがあり、月間検索数の調査では海外の地域・言語の指定にも対応しています。利用にはラッコキーワードのアカウントが必要です。
